articles.title: 這下虧大了！網友買到外掛玩家的二手CPU 整台主機連坐被官方封死
articles.excerpt:
處理器、記憶體、顯示卡、主機板都是 PC 市場熱門的二手零件，買賣時除了檢查外觀與功能外，有時可能也要詢問淘汰下來的原因，否則可能會買到遭到線上遊戲官方硬體鎖定的產品，導致裝上新電腦後被系統判定連坐，遭受無辜的波及。

 

 

處理器、記憶體、顯示卡、主機板都是 PC 市場熱門的二手零件，買賣時除了檢查外觀與功能外，有時可能也要詢問淘汰下來的原因，否則可能會買到遭到線上遊戲官方硬體鎖定的產品，導致裝上新電腦後被系統判定連坐，遭受無辜的波及。

 

德國 Reddit 網友 After-Cartoonist-196 分享他二手交易的慘痛經驗，在二手交易網站了一顆 Ryzen 7 5800X3D 處理器，希望以此提升《特戰英豪》的遊戲表現。

 

 Posts from the pcbaumeister 

community on Reddit 

 

但沒想到，這顆處理器的前任主人就是因為在《特戰英豪》開外掛被抓，導致主機上的硬體設備遭到鎖定，於是這些設備就流入二手市場，輾轉來到這位苦主上。

 

更慘的是，因為遊戲檢測到「有前科」的處理器被安裝到與過往不同的設備上，直接觸發二次封鎖，系統連同該網友原本正常的主機板、硬碟等零組件一併標記封鎖。讓問題已經不是拔下這顆 Ryzen 7 5800X3D 那麼簡單，而是整台電腦都被永久擋在遊戲門外。

 

關於此情況，除了整台換新之外，唯一的處理方式是將相關購買憑證、遊戲截圖等必要資訊交給遊戲客服進行專人處理，在繁瑣的文書與曠日廢時的往返，才有機會還給玩家清白。

 

目前許多遊戲廠商如本次的《特戰英豪》、《APEX 英雄》、《決勝時刻系列》等，都有加入 HWID（硬體識別碼） 封鎖的外掛懲罰機制，會將外掛使用者主要硬體設備編號登記並封鎖，使其無法單純重辦一個帳號來繼續作惡，希望透過高成本的代價來嚇阻違規行為。

 

不過這確實也導致二手市場會流出已經被封殺的設備，特別是處理器、顯示卡、主機板這三大核心零件，且許多賣家也不會特別告知，玩家買二手零件除了要找有信譽的商家外，價格過於便宜的商品也許要多加留意，或是在下單之前，額外詢問貨品來源或其背景歷史。

articles.title: 科技業職缺逾 28 萬、裁員砍半：AI 沒消滅工作，而是改寫了徵才名單

AI 原本被認為可能大幅消滅科技業工作，但最新職缺數據顯示，科技公司的招聘需求並未全面萎縮，職缺數量較年初明顯增加。其中，硬體工程師需求更在今年明顯成長，顯示 AI 帶動的不只是軟體開發，也正在推升晶片、伺服器、機器人與資料中心等實體基礎建設的人才需求。 《Business Insider》報導，根據招聘平台 TrueUp 的最新數據，科技公司的職缺數量正在增加。TrueUp 追蹤超過 9,000 家科技公司，目前統計的新創公司與大型科技企業共有超過 28 萬個科技職缺，較 2026 年初大幅增加。 科技職缺增至逾 28 萬個：硬體工程師需求因 AI 基建大增 科技業裁員情況也持續放緩。TrueUp 數據顯示，今年截至目前約有 19 萬名科技業員工遭到裁員，明顯低於 2023 年產業裁員高峰期的約 43 萬人。雖然裁員並未完全消失，但已不像疫情後產業下滑期間那樣快速發生。 不過，科技業的復甦並非所有職類都同步發生。今年對硬體工程師的需求大幅增加，主要受到企業大規模投入 AI 基礎建設所帶動。「考量到市場對 GPU 創新、AI 機器人、美國製造業新創公司以及 SpaceX 的關注，這並不令人意外。」TrueUp 創辦人 Amit Taylor 告訴《Business Insider》。 另一方面，軟體工程職缺的表現也比預期更加穩健。儘管市場先前預測，AI 程式設計工具普及後，企業對程式設計師的需求可能大幅下降，但目前數據並未顯示軟體工程職缺出現明顯萎縮。 《The Pragmatic Engineer》今年 5 月發布的 2026 年科技就業市場分析，也觀察到軟體工程招聘正在回升，但不同市場之間存在明顯差異。該報告引用 Indeed 的職缺數據指出，美國與英國的軟體工程職缺增加，加拿大大致持平，德國與法國則出現下降。報告認為，這可能反映出以美國為總部的科技公司正在增加軟體工程師招聘，主要集中在美國以及部分英國市場，而歐洲總部的科技公司招聘則相對謹慎。 Google 工程職缺增 62%，AI […]

AI 原本被認為可能大幅消滅科技業工作，但最新職缺數據顯示，科技公司的招聘需求並未全面萎縮，職缺數量較年初明顯增加。其中，硬體工程師需求更在今年明顯成長，顯示 AI 帶動的不只是軟體開發，也正在推升晶片、伺服器、機器人與資料中心等實體基礎建設的人才需求。

《Business Insider》報導，根據招聘平台 TrueUp 的最新數據，科技公司的職缺數量正在增加。TrueUp 追蹤超過 9,000 家科技公司，目前統計的新創公司與大型科技企業共有超過 28 萬個科技職缺，較 2026 年初大幅增加。

科技職缺增至逾 28 萬個：硬體工程師需求因 AI 基建大增

科技業裁員情況也持續放緩。TrueUp 數據顯示，今年截至目前約有 19 萬名科技業員工遭到裁員，明顯低於 2023 年產業裁員高峰期的約 43 萬人。雖然裁員並未完全消失，但已不像疫情後產業下滑期間那樣快速發生。

不過，科技業的復甦並非所有職類都同步發生。今年對硬體工程師的需求大幅增加，主要受到企業大規模投入 AI 基礎建設所帶動。「考量到市場對 GPU 創新、AI 機器人、美國製造業新創公司以及 SpaceX 的關注，這並不令人意外。」TrueUp 創辦人 Amit Taylor 告訴《Business Insider》。

另一方面，軟體工程職缺的表現也比預期更加穩健。儘管市場先前預測，AI 程式設計工具普及後，企業對程式設計師的需求可能大幅下降，但目前數據並未顯示軟體工程職缺出現明顯萎縮。

《The Pragmatic Engineer》今年 5 月發布的 2026 年科技就業市場分析，也觀察到軟體工程招聘正在回升，但不同市場之間存在明顯差異。該報告引用 Indeed 的職缺數據指出，美國與英國的軟體工程職缺增加，加拿大大致持平，德國與法國則出現下降。報告認為，這可能反映出以美國為總部的科技公司正在增加軟體工程師招聘，主要集中在美國以及部分英國市場，而歐洲總部的科技公司招聘則相對謹慎。

Google 工程職缺增 62%，AI 工程成科技業招聘新焦點

從企業來看，《The Pragmatic Engineer》整理 TrueUp 數據發現，目前軟體工程職缺數量最多的科技公司前三名仍是 Apple、IBM 與 Amazon。大型科技公司中，Apple 與 Google 的招聘都比去年積極，其中 Google 的工程職缺數量較去年增加 62%；此外，Micron、Qualcomm 與 AMD 等硬體公司，今年公布的軟體工程職缺也較去年明顯增加。

部分科技公司的工程團隊則在過去兩年快速擴張。《The Pragmatic Engineer》引用的 Workforce.ai 數據顯示，金融科技公司 Ramp 的軟體工程師人數增加 94%，資安公司 Wiz 增加 84%，可觀測性公司 Datadog 增加 68%，金融科技公司 Rippling 增加 55%，設計工具公司 Figma 則增加 41%。其中，Datadog 的成長與 AI 代理帶動對可觀測性需求增加有關；Figma 則持續投入 Figma AI 等 AI 相關產品。

更明顯的變化出現在 AI 工程領域。《The Pragmatic Engineer》指出，AI 工程的招聘需求正快速上升，且多數科技公司目前似乎優先招募 AI 工程人才，而非一般軟體工程師。該報告去年就將 AI 工程視為科技業職缺成長最快的領域，今年這項趨勢仍在延續。

這些數據顯示，AI 帶來的變化更像是在改變科技公司「招聘什麼人才」，而不是讓企業完全停止招聘。隨著 AI 投資持續增加，人才需求正逐漸轉向打造 AI 實體基礎的工程師，包括晶片、伺服器、機器人、製造業與資料中心等領域；另一方面，軟體工程招聘仍維持一定程度的韌性，AI 工程則成為成長速度更快的新興人才需求。

＊本文開放合作夥伴轉載，資料來源： 《Business Insider》 、 《The Pragmatic Engineer》 ，圖片來源： Unsplash 。

articles.title: 《彩虹島物語》「迷霧森林」全新改版登場！探訪恪爾立祕境，勇闖全新四人副本
articles.excerpt:
樂意傳播代理的橫向捲軸可愛風格線上遊戲《彩虹島物語》，於上週（1）日迎來 2026 年全新一波改版「迷霧森林」！本次更新揭開了東方大陸深處恪爾立部族的神秘面紗，同步開放全新原野地區、兩款四人副本「卡美洛牧場」與「沉默螺旋」，以及多項職業平衡調整、養成減負優化與「秋日野餐」系列活動，邀請所有島民一同踏入迷霧，揭開隱藏在森林中的真相！

 

迷霧籠罩的神秘家園，恪爾立部族危機

　　隨著預言中令人焦急的時刻臨近，冒險家為了尋找對抗危機的方法，與因無聊而現身的地下都市塔爾達洛斯主人「煞尼克」結伴，前往位於東方大陸幽靜之地「迷霧森林」。

 

　　這片長期被濃霧籠罩的森林，是長著動物耳朵的奇特「恪爾立部族」的故鄉。原先平靜祥和的村莊，隨著守護森林的霧氣消散，轉而被沉重的黑暗侵蝕。面對戴伊墨斯教團狂信徒的逼近，部族領導者為了保護族人與村莊，做出讓時間停滯的決斷，使整個村莊與異樣的光之漩渦一同陷入無限的沉默之中⋯⋯

 

雙重四人副本開放，挑戰狂暴魔獸與女神化身

　　本次改版同步開放兩個全新四人副本「卡美洛牧場」與「沉默螺旋」：

 

　　「卡美洛牧場」：位於阿瓦隆邊緣未受汙染的草木之地，曾是狂信徒照料魔獸的場所。如今狂暴的魔獸群在「隊長卡美洛」的率領下發起叛亂，試圖將牧場佔為己有，正等待著冒險家前往平息叛亂！

 

　　「沉默螺旋」：位於恪爾立村莊中心湧動的彩虹光束漩渦中。徘徊於螺旋深處的強大 BOSS「薇奈特」，原本是尋找生命意義的女神化身，卻在負面情緒糾纏下化為最邪惡的形態，唯有強大的勇者才能將她從黑暗中救贖。

 

職業與系統大優化，戰鬥成長全面減負

　　為了提供更順暢的冒險體驗，開發團隊於本次改版針對職業與遊戲系統進行了多項優化與調整：

 

　　職業與技能平衡：針對 25 個技能效率較低的職業調高傷害輸出，並優化技能實用效果；同時將部分副職業移動型技能轉為基本效果，大幅提升初期成長與戰鬥便利性。

 

　　副本與養成減負：熱門副本「魔法廳大樓」與「曼基康倉庫」之怪物攻擊力與 HP 皆調降 30%，並新增經驗值副本第 5 階段難度；超人點數升級與提升等級所需點數更大幅減少 90%，讓玩家戰力提升更輕鬆！

 

秋日野餐活動開跑，豐富限定獎勵輕鬆拿

　　歡慶改版，官方特別推出「秋日野餐」系列活動！活動期間每日登入簽到即可獲得豐厚好禮，完成活動任務與限定迷你遊戲「重返愛的高速公路」，還能兌換豐富限定道具並能獲得改版特別祝福。

 

　　此外，商城同步推出全新裝備部位「永恆手錶」、甜美風格的「甜點／甜點師」系列時裝與髮型、皇家限定坐騎「紫色閃電之翼」，以及全新一季戰鬥通行證限定髮型「酒紅色摩登捲髮＆短髮」，讓島民們能以嶄新造型迎接秋季冒險！

 

　　《彩虹島物語》最新改版「迷霧森林」現已正式上線，快召集夥伴一同前往迷霧深處冒險吧！更多改版細節與活動資訊，請至官方網站與官方粉絲團查詢！

articles.title: Stripe’s OpenRouter Deal Signals AI-Driven Hybrid Payment Routing
articles.excerpt:
A $7bn-plus acquisition of AI gateway OpenRouter positions Stripe to route transactions intelligently across fiat and stablecoin rails.

The post Stripe’s OpenRouter Deal Signals AI-Driven Hybrid Payment Routing appeared first on The Fintech Times .

Stripe ‘s reported acquisition of AI gateway OpenRouter , valued at more than $7 billion, is being read by payments executives as confirmation that the next competitive frontier in cross-border infrastructure is not the rail itself but the intelligence layer above it. Coming shortly after Stripe acquired stablecoin infrastructure firm Bridge , the OpenRouter deal suggests a deliberate strategy: own both the alternative financial plumbing and the routing logic that decides which pipe to use.

 Vadim Drozd , chief executive of Lithuanian payment orchestration platform FinteqHub , argues the deal reflects a structural shift already under way in how money moves across borders. “Stablecoins promise to make cross-border payments faster and cheaper,” he said. “But for businesses moving money across multiple markets, the reality is more complicated.”

 Why stablecoins alone are not enough 

Drozd’s central argument is that stablecoins are moving from the fringes of treasury operations into core cross-border payment infrastructure, but that building exclusively on stablecoin rails introduces a different category of risk rather than eliminating an existing one. Regulation remains fragmented across jurisdictions, banks apply inconsistent treatment to stablecoin-denominated transactions, and merchant and consumer adoption outside a handful of markets is still limited.

The practical implication, he contends, is a hybrid model in which stablecoins operate alongside traditional currencies, correspondent banking, payment service providers and local payment methods. In that environment, the value shifts from the rail to the routing decision. Drozd cited the potential for AI-driven routing to reduce transaction costs by 75% or more in high-volume cross-border operations by continuously optimising across fiat and stablecoin paths, though this figure is a forward-looking estimate and has not been independently verified.

 Orchestration as the new infrastructure layer 

The broader market context supports the directional claim, even if the headline cost-reduction figure warrants scrutiny. Routing logic in most payment stacks today relies on static, manually maintained rules that do not automatically respond to changes in PSP fees, settlement availability, throughput limits or counterparty performance. The argument that machine-learning models can turn that static configuration into a continuously optimised system is not new, but the commercial pressure to act on it is growing as the number of viable rails multiplies.

Several payment orchestration platforms, including Primer , Spreedly and Payrails , are already competing in the space Drozd describes, connecting businesses to multiple acquirers and processors and applying routing logic across them. Stripe’s acquisition of OpenRouter, if confirmed at the reported scale, would introduce a well-capitalised and vertically integrated competitor into that segment, combining stablecoin settlement capability with AI-powered routing in a single vendor.

The regulatory dimension is equally important. The EU’s Markets in Crypto-Assets regulation (MiCA) is now in force for stablecoins and introduces a licensing and reserve regime that will affect how platforms route through euro-denominated stablecoin instruments. In the UK, the Financial Conduct Authority ‘s stablecoin rules remain under consultation, adding further jurisdictional complexity for any operator designing a hybrid rail strategy across the two largest European markets.

For payment teams evaluating infrastructure decisions now, the signal from Stripe’s acquisition activity is that the window for operating a simple, single-rail stack is narrowing. The firms best positioned to compete will need either a sophisticated in-house orchestration capability or a vendor relationship that can abstract the routing complexity across an expanding set of fiat and digital-asset settlement options.

The post Stripe’s OpenRouter Deal Signals AI-Driven Hybrid Payment Routing appeared first on The Fintech Times .

articles.title: 卡普空開源次世代RE引擎根基「RE:Dox」 AI加速資料處理最快近3倍
articles.excerpt:
卡普空（Capcom）將旗下最新資料顯示與序列化基礎函式庫「RE:Dox」以開放原始碼軟體（OSS）形式公開，作為卡普空次世代遊戲引擎計畫 REX（RE neXt ENGINE）的基礎技術，除了開放外部開發者自由使用，也揭示卡普空逐步改造 RE ENGINE、導入 AI 與機器學習技術的方向。

 

 

卡普空（Capcom）將旗下最新資料顯示與序列化基礎函式庫「RE:Dox」以開放原始碼軟體（OSS）形式公開，作為卡普空次世代遊戲引擎計畫 REX（RE neXt ENGINE）的基礎技術，除了開放外部開發者自由使用，也揭示卡普空逐步改造 RE ENGINE、導入 AI 與機器學習技術的方向。

 

卡普空目前使用的「RE ENGINE」最早應用在《惡靈古堡 7 生化危機》，近年則陸續支援《魔物獵人 荒野》、《人機迷網》與《鬼武者 Way of the Sword》等作品。

 

卡普空早在 2023 年 10 月 便公開 REX 引擎計畫 ，目標是針對 RE ENGINE 長期使用後逐漸浮現的問題進行改善，以階段性更新讓引擎邁向下一世代，如今卡普空於 10 月 2、3 日在東京舉辦技術展示活動「CAPCOM Open Conference RE:2026」，便以 REX 計畫展望作為開場，同步公開構成 REX 的基礎技術之一「RE:Dox」。

 

 

📢「CAPCOM オープンカンファレンス RE:2026」開幕！ 本日はいよいよ開催初日です！👍 カプコンのゲーム開発技術や開発現場のリアルをお届けするさまざまな講演・展示をご用意しています。 会場の様子や講演情報は、このアカウントでも随時発信していきます！ #RE2026CAPCOM https://t.co/ExEi55Dcdc

— カプコン技研 公式アカウント (@CAPCOM_RandD) October 2, 2026 

 

卡普空的 「RE:Dox」是針對 .NET 的 Token-based 結構化資料引擎，主要用途是將不同資料轉換成統一的格式與規則，藉此加速資料處理、編輯與讀取。

 

卡普空在 GitHub 的 README 提供實際範例 ，以玩家資料為例，原本以 JSON 形式記錄的角色資料可透過 RE:Dox 提供的類別處理，如建立一名 42 級持手槍與綠色藥草的里昂，接著讀取資料並將角色名稱改成「克蕾兒」，甚至追加「小刀」等道具。

 

根據官方公開的基準測試，在平行處理 JSON 反序列化（deserialization）時，RE:Dox 相較 .NET 標準的 System.Text.Json 理論上最快可達約 2.84 倍的處理速度，實際運作的結果則可能會受到資料結構、執行環境與 CPU 等條件影響。

 

RE:Dox 目前已經以 Apache-2.0 授權條款開放原始碼，只要符合授權條件，開發者就可以自由使用、修改，甚至應用於商業用途。

 

 

 

RE:Dox 的公開只是 REX 計畫的一部分，卡普空在此次技術研討會說明，REX 將由 6 個不同計畫構成，逐步把 AI 與機器學習技術整合至 RE ENGINE 的開發環境。

 

其中，RE:Dox 負責改善資料處理效率；「RE:UI」則著重於利用 AI 協助最佳化 RE ENGINE 的開發工具。另有「RE:Runtime」等技術，目標是讓大量物件與角色能夠以群組方式進行動畫處理，而不是逐一執行即時動畫，以降低開發與運算負擔。

 

 

 

較受矚目的技術還有「RE:Flows」，旨在簡化遊戲機制的實作流程，讓開發者更容易將遊戲玩法構想轉換成標準化的程式語言，從目前公開的方向來看，相關工具更接近利用 AI 與自動化技術協助程式開發，而不是直接使用生成式 AI 製作遊戲素材。

 

卡普空表示，當代遊戲的規模與技術複雜度持續增加，資料管理已經成為開發上的重大課題，目前採用 RE ENGINE 的開發者已經超過 2,000 人，且來自不同國家，因此需要建立更容易被不同開發者理解與使用的開發環境。

 

相較目前頗具爭議的生成式 AI 導入開發，卡普空曾表示不會將 AI 生成的素材直接放進遊戲內容，但會利用 AI 技術「提升效率與生產力」，目前公開的 REX 技術也集中在資料處理、工具最佳化、程式開發與運算效率等層面，堅持不以 AI 直接生成角色、美術素材等遊戲內容。

 

RE:Dox 第二場技術展示活動「CAPCOM Open Conference RE:2026」開放參與的對象以職業學校、大學在校生、研究生為主，將於 10 月 17、18 日在大阪大阪哈比斯商廈（HERBIS OSAKA）的宴會廳舉行。

 

 

無事に「CAPCOM オープンカンファレンス RE:2026」の東京開催分が終わりました！ ご来場いただいた皆様ありがとうございました🙇‍♂️ 次は10/17,18に大阪会場でお会いしましょう！✨ #RE2026CAPCOM https://t.co/WEsTvm848D

— カプコン技研 公式アカウント (@CAPCOM_RandD) October 3, 2026

articles.title: Ethereum Price Analysis: ETH Holds Bullish Structure, but $2.8K Remains the Key Hurdle
articles.excerpt:
Ethereum is holding at $2.7K after another rejection from overhead resistance. Ethereum is holding at $2.7K after another rejection from overhead resistance. Buyers have preserved the broader upward structure, but a sustained breakout is still needed to turn the current consolidation into a fresh bullish leg.

Ethereum Price Analysis: The Daily Chart

On the daily chart, Ethereum continues to consolidate around the lower boundary of the $2.68K–$2.77K resistance zone. Several candles have produced upper wicks within this area, highlighting persistent selling pressure. However, the relatively shallow pullback suggests that buyers remain active beneath resistance.

The broader outlook remains constructive, with ETH trading above the ascending trendline and both displayed moving averages. The yellow moving average has crossed above the orange average and continues to rise, reinforcing the recovery structure. This bullish crossover provides a supportive backdrop, although price still needs to clear the nearby supply zone.

A decisive daily close above $2.77K, followed by a break of the recent high around $2.8K, could pave the way toward the $2.9K–$3K resistance zone. Conversely, a loss of the consolidation lows around $2.64K would increase the likelihood of a deeper correction toward the rising trendline and the highlighted $2.36K–$2.42K support zone.

 

ETH/USDT 4-Hour Chart

The 4-hour chart shows Ethereum trading within an ascending channel. Following its rejection near the upper boundary around $2.78K, the price pulled back toward the channel’s midpoint and has since recovered to approximately $2.7K. This suggests that the latest decline has so far remained a correction within the broader upward structure.

The immediate obstacle remains the $2.68K–$2.77K supply zone. Holding above the channel midpoint around $2.67K could support another attempt to clear this barrier. A successful breakout would bring the upper channel boundary, currently around $2.8K–$2.82K, into focus.

However, a sustained move below the midpoint and the recent $2.65K lows would weaken the near-term outlook. Such a development could expose the $2.63K and $2.58K support areas, followed by the $2.44K–$2.48K demand zone. The channel’s lower boundary approaches this demand area, making it an important region for preserving the broader bullish structure.

 

Sentiment Analysis

The two-week Binance ETH/USDT liquidation heatmap shows substantial estimated liquidation clusters above and below the current price. A particularly bright overhead band sits around $2.78K–$2.8K, with additional concentrations extending toward $2.85K. Below price, a prominent cluster appears around $2.61K–$2.63K, alongside a broader concentration across the $2.55K–$2.6K region.

The overhead cluster closely aligns with the recent price highs and the upper portion of the technical resistance area. If buyers establish a sustained breakout above $2.77K, short liquidations around $2.78K–$2.8K could amplify the advance. Nevertheless, reaching this liquidity would not itself confirm that ETH can sustain higher prices.

Conversely, losing the nearby channel support could bring the $2.61K–$2.63K liquidation pool into play, potentially accelerating a decline as leveraged longs unwind. Ethereum therefore remains between two substantial liquidity concentrations, with the direction of a confirmed technical break likely to determine which pool becomes relevant first.

 

The post Ethereum Price Analysis: ETH Holds Bullish Structure, but $2.8K Remains the Key Hurdle appeared first on CryptoPotato .

articles.title: 跨入Wi-Fi 8新紀元！ TP-Link發表全球首款Wi-Fi 8旗艦路由器Archer 8 Ultra
articles.excerpt:
TP-Link 於10 月 1 日舉辦全球直播線上發表會，宣布旗下首款 Wi-Fi 8 路由器 Archer 8 Ultra 正式開放英國、德國、澳洲等市場預購，揭開新一代居家網路連線序幕。

 

 

TP-Link 於10 月 1 日舉辦全球直播線上發表會，宣布旗下首款 Wi-Fi 8 路由器 Archer 8 Ultra 正式開放英國、德國、澳洲等市場預購，揭開新一代居家網路連線序幕。

 

Wi-Fi 8 象徵網路通訊產業的重要轉折，相較過往世代追求高速連網，Wi-Fi 8 更聚焦於實際使用情境下的穩定性，即使面對日常生活中複雜的網路環境，仍能維持穩定的連線效能。全新 Archer 8 Ultra 採用 TP-Link Wi-Fi 8 StabilityEngine 核心技術，提供全球消費者前所未有的網路連線體驗。

 

TP-Link 研發資深副總裁 Jim Poder 表示：「Wi-Fi 8 奠定新一代無線網路的基礎，而我們更進一步拓展其可能性。Archer 8 Ultra 結合 Wi-Fi 8 StabilityEngine、智慧天線技術與 AI 智慧優化功能，聚焦使用者需求，提供更智慧、更可靠、更容易上手的網路體驗。」

 

TP-Link 核心技術 Wi-Fi 8 StabilityEngine 全面破解死角、干擾與多機壅塞痛點

傳統無線網路往往過度追求極限峰值速度，卻忽略了日常實際使用中的干擾與穩定性。TP-Link 的 Wi-Fi 8 StabilityEngine 巧妙結合了次世代 Wi-Fi 8 技術，不僅能強化連線品質、智慧管理干擾，更能高效率地在家庭各角落分配頻寬容量。 

 

Archer 8 Ultra 上市即支援多項突破性的核心技術，針對居家三大上網痛點提供完美解答：

 

穿牆抗擾，干擾下維持穩定： 日常生活中，厚重牆壁、家電運作以及周邊網路常造成訊號干擾，即使是高速連線也難免受影響。

 

 Archer 8 Ultra 透過全新的 MCS（調變與編碼機制）、UEQM（非均等調變技術） 以及 2×LDPC，大幅降低距離與外界干擾對資料傳輸的衝擊。經 TP-Link 內部測試顯示，其在中長距離下相較 Wi-Fi 7 可提供高達 33％ 更穩定的吞吐量，在惡劣干擾環境下，也能維持最高 24％ 的穩定效能提升。

 

 
多機齊上，連接更多裝置時保持一致： 當家庭成員與智慧連網設備同時在線，裝置間爭奪傳輸時間往往會導致網路慢下來。透過 DSO（動態子頻段運作）及 NPCA（非主通道存取） 技術，路由器能更彈性、有效地運用無線通道與分享容量，確保網路在連接大量裝置時依然能隨時保持靈敏與即時回應。 

 

 
訊號延伸，邊緣連線更強大： 家中死角或位於訊號邊緣的遠端裝置，經常面臨訊號微弱甚至斷線的困擾。透過全面強化的硬體與 RF 晶片設計，讓訊號能夠穩定觸及每個角落。 

 

此外，隨著 Wi-Fi 8 標準與生態系持續成熟，TP-Link 也預告未來將透過 OTA（空中下載）韌體更新 陸續解鎖更多高階技術，包括進一步擴大裝置承載量的 DSO（動態子頻段運作），以及大幅強化居家邊緣與低功耗裝置覆蓋的 ELR（增強型長距離傳輸）與 DRU（分散式資源單元）。 

 

 
 TP-Link 核心技術 Wi-Fi 8 StabilityEngine 有效強化連線品質、智慧管理干擾，高效率在家庭各角落分配頻寬容量。 

 

Archer 8 Ultra 聚集頂尖硬體規格、兼具精緻設計，為消費者帶來前所未有的極致連線體驗

作為 TP-Link 首款 Wi-Fi 8 路由器，Archer 8 Ultra 搭載博通（Broadcom）全新 Wi-Fi 8 晶片組，採用 IEEE 802.11bn 標準打造的次世代技術架構，結合由 TP-Link 美國設計與研發團隊主導的軟硬體技術。

 

Archer 8 Ultra 提供高達 19 Gbps 的三頻 Wi-Fi 8 連線，在相同距離下，較 Wi-Fi 7 能提供更穩定的網路效能與更低的延遲。機身配備 2 組 10 Gbps 自動偵測 WAN／LAN 連接埠，可支援多 Gigabit 網路方案；另搭載 4 組 2.5 Gbps LAN 連接埠，為電腦、遊戲主機等高效能設備提供穩定的有線連線。

 

同時內建高達 18 支的高效能天線，訊號覆蓋範圍最高可達 3,600 平方英尺（約 334 平方公尺），最多支援 200 台裝置同時連線，為高流量、多裝置的居家環境提供高速且穩定的連線體驗。

 

 
 Archer 8 Ultra 內建高達 18 支高效能天線，訊號覆蓋最高可達約 334 平方公尺，提供更大範圍、高速、穩定的連線體驗。 

 

為突破複雜的居家空間限制，Archer 8 Ultra 更具備針對多空間打造的先進覆蓋技術：

 

Multi-Floor Mode 多樓層模式自動分布訊號：能自動偵測裝置所在位置動態分布訊號。當裝置分布於不同樓層時，能將訊號導向多個樓層；若裝置集中於同一樓層，則可將訊號調整為更廣的單層覆蓋模式。

 

 
Range Boost 技術強化邊緣覆蓋力：全新 Wi-Fi 8 RF 晶片搭載 Range Boost 技術，進一步提升路由器接收遠距、低功耗裝置訊號的能力，改善位於訊號覆蓋邊緣時，因裝置上行訊號較弱所造成的連線瓶頸。

 

 

 
 TP-Link 搭載多種連接阜、支援多種網路方案，為電腦、遊戲主機等高效能設備提供穩定的有線連線。 

 

AI 智慧管理全面融入打造直覺連網體驗

全新 Archer 8 Ultra 更將 AI 智慧管理導入系統中。TP-Link Tether App 內建 Aireal AI Assistant 智慧助理，從使用者互動與自動化網路管理兩層面提升使用體驗。

 

使用者可直接以口頭詢問 AI 智慧助理網路相關問題，更直覺地了解並管理家中 Wi-Fi，同時，AI 也同步於背景自動運作，協助維持穩定連線。其中，Wi-Fi Optimizer（Wi-Fi 最佳化工具）可持續將路由器調整至較佳的無線頻道，Self-Healing（自我修復）能自動處理常見網路問題，QoS 可優先分配頻寬給重要的網路流量，ECO 模式則可在離峰時段降低耗電，提升能源使用效率。

 

 
 Tether App 內建 Aireal AI 智慧助理，從使用者互動與自動化網路管理提升使用體驗。 

 

NFC 快速配對，兼具高效能與安全防護

產品安裝也更加簡易，初次使用時僅需將手機輕觸路由器，即可透過 NFC 與 App 快速配對．內建的硬體級 VPN 可直接在路由器上對選定設備的流量進行加密，並相容第三方 VPN 供應商，獨立的訪客與物聯網（IoT）網路則可將具安全漏洞的設備隔離於主網路之外。

 

用戶還可以選擇加入 TP-Link 的 HomeShield 家庭照護服務，獲得即時保護、進階家長監護與 WPA3 驗證。輕鬆打造兼具高速、智慧且安全的次世代居家網路環境。

 

 
 TP-Link 打造更直覺、更智慧的次世代連網體驗，只需將手機輕觸路由器即可透過 NFC 完成 App 配對。 

 

Wi-Fi 8 深入大家庭、大範圍場域，全屋覆蓋系統 Deco 8 Ultra 2026 IFA 全新亮相

隨著 2026 IFA 展期圓滿落幕，TP-Link 旗下全新推出的 Deco 8 Ultra 三頻 Wi-Fi 8 Mesh 系統持續受到市場高度關注。該產品具備 22 Gbps 無線傳輸與 10 Gbps 有線連接能力，三入組最高可涵蓋 275 坪並支援逾 200 台裝置連線，是打造大坪數、多樓層全屋高速網路的旗艦首選，更在此次展會中榮獲 2026 年 IFA 創新獎（IFA Innovation Award）肯定。

 

Archer 8 Ultra 已率先自 9 月 30 日於英國、德國、澳洲等海外市場開放預購，也預計持續將 Wi‑Fi 8 技術延伸至更多居家連網產品，Archer 8 Ultra 與即將推出的 Deco 8 Ultra 全球各地市場上市時程也將陸續公布。

articles.title: 保護基金全額兜底、提領後資金反增：Bitget 五天扳回局面的關鍵
articles.excerpt:
作者：WhiteRunner 過去幾年，交易所遭遇大型安全事件並不罕見，攻擊入口也從熱錢包、簽名系統逐漸延伸至 […]

這篇文章 保護基金全額兜底、提領後資金反增：Bitget 五天扳回局面的關鍵 最早出現於 鏈新聞 ABMedia 。

作者：WhiteRunner

過去幾年，交易所遭遇大型安全事件並不罕見，攻擊入口也從熱錢包、簽名系統逐漸延伸至內部權限和第三方服務。隨著系統愈來愈複雜，交易所需要防守的邊界也愈來愈大。

9 月 25 日，Bitget 遭遇安全事件，最終確認約 3.88 億美元資產受到影響。CEO Gracy Chen 隨後在直播中表示，這是平台營運八年來首次發生此類安全事件。根據 SlowMist 公布的調查結果，最早發現的惡意活動涉及一款第三方安全產品節點上的零日漏洞。Mandiant 與 SlowMist 的調查均將攻擊路徑指向第三方安全基礎設施遭入侵，並最終進入 Bitget 的錢包環境。

事故發生後，Bitget 宣布由用戶保護基金承擔損失。事發時，這支於 2022 年設立的基金持有 5,500 BTC，價值超過 4.64 億美元。Gracy 承諾，保護基金在使用後將於一週內補足至 3 億美元，恢復至 2022 年設立時確定的基準規模。9 月 30 日，這一承諾已如期兌現。

提領也開始按照此前公布的時間表恢復。9 月 28 日 16:00，BTC 首先開放提領；29 日 ETH 恢復提領後，相關熱錢包從淨流出迅速轉為淨流入，很快餘額甚至已略高於提領開放前的初始水準，用戶的信任正在回歸。截至發稿時，所有幣種均已恢復提領。

從近 4 億美元被盜，到提領恢復、資金重新流入，中間只過去了幾天。駭客究竟如何在私鑰沒有洩漏的情況下轉走資產？一支準備了四年的保護基金如何真正派上用場？Bitget 又做了什麼，讓事件開始出現轉折？

駭客利用零日漏洞攻破第三方安全產品

這次攻擊較特別的一點，是 Bitget 的私鑰沒有洩漏，冷錢包也沒有被攻破，更不是智慧合約漏洞。駭客找到的突破口，竟然是平台使用的一款第三方安全產品。

 

根據 Bitget 目前披露的調查結果，北京時間 9 月 25 日 02:31 左右，鏈上出現了最早確認的相關小額轉帳，隨後開始出現更大規模的資產轉移。

Gracy 在接受 The Block 採訪時表示，從 02:58 至 04:09，攻擊者透過 Ethereum、XRP、Zcash、BNB Chain、Base、Arbitrum、Optimism 和 Avalanche 等多個網路進行了 17 筆大額交易。隨著後續統計補充，Bitget 最終確認此次事件影響約 3.88 億美元資產。

03:05，也就是第一筆大額轉帳發生約 7 分鐘後，Bitget 的對帳系統發現明顯資金差異並觸發全平台提領阻斷；03:14，平台啟動最高級別緊急應變。由於當時還不能排除私鑰洩漏，錢包團隊隨後將資產轉移至冷錢包，並關閉錢包提領和簽名服務。

隨後，安全團隊確認事件根因。按照目前公布的攻擊鏈，駭客利用的是一款第三方安全產品此前未知的零日漏洞。

 

所謂零日漏洞，是指廠商和使用方此前尚未掌握、也沒有現成修補程式可以提前部署的安全缺陷。換句話說，這是一條此前未知的攻擊入口。接下來發生的事情，才是理解這次近 4 億美元損失的關鍵。

利用這一漏洞，攻擊者透過第三方安全產品的漏洞竊取內網權限憑證，向錢包系統偽造提領指令，欺騙錢包執行了繞過風險校驗的異常轉帳。整個過程中私鑰未洩漏，冷錢包也未受影響。

 

Gracy 此後還透露，攻擊者完成操作後刪除了部分相關痕跡，增加了調查和還原攻擊過程的難度。

Bitget 此後停用了受影響的第三方功能，並重新簽發內部憑證、收回和重新拆分高敏感權限，同時對提領增加獨立校驗。Mandiant 和 SlowMist 目前仍在參與獨立鑑識調查和資金追蹤。

這次事件給產業留下的一個直接警示是，交易所的安全邊界已不只是私鑰和冷錢包。安全軟體、錢包基礎設施以及其他能夠接觸核心系統的第三方服務，本身也可能成為攻擊入口。

保護基金開始動用，提領按時間表恢復

事件發生後，接下來真正檢驗一家交易所的，是面對損失時該由誰承擔，以及管理層如何面對和安撫用戶。

Bitget 首先動用了保護基金。

這支基金在 2022 年設立，並長期以 3 億美元作為基準規模。事故發生時，基金持有 5,500 BTC，價值超過 4.64 億美元，足以覆蓋最終確認的約 3.88 億美元受損金額。

Bitget 隨後明確表示，由保護基金承擔此次事件造成的資金影響，用戶帳戶餘額不受影響。

9 月 28 日 BTC 恢復提領之前，鏈上已經可以看到保護基金開始向熱錢包調撥資產。鏈上分析師 Ai 姨監測到，最初有 2,042.28 BTC 從相關保護基金地址轉入 Bitget 熱錢包（ Bitget 保護基金鏈上監測 ）。

這是 Bitget 此次處理最值得產業參考的地方之一。

這個保護基金不是事故發生以後臨時宣布的賠付方案，而是在四年前就已經建立。資金長期儲備，錢包地址公開可查，同時有明確的規模基準；真正發生事故以後實際調用，使用之後再按照原來的標準補充。

保護基金解決了損失承擔的問題。這一次，近 4 億美元的損失最終沒有轉嫁給用戶。Gracy 表示，Bitget 將在一週內把保護基金重新補充至至少 3 億美元，從鏈上監測情況來看已如期履行。

 

Bitget 也在 9 月 30 日發布第 47 期儲備金證明（PoR），總儲備金率達 131%，涵蓋 19 類資產。其中，BTC、ETH、USDT 及 USDC 的儲備金率分別為 142%、110%、107% 和 154%。

 

資金之外，Bitget 這幾天的溝通方式同樣值得關注。

Gracy 在面向社群的直播中連續回應了約三個小時，謝家印也持續透過社群媒體和社群更新進展。直播三個小時本身不是重點，更重要的是，在事故最混亂的幾天裡，管理層始終站在第一線回應問題。

 

而且幾次關鍵發聲基本都給出了明確的資訊或下一步方案。

損失由誰承擔，很快明確由保護基金覆蓋；影響金額從 3.516 億美元調整至 3.88 億美元後，也解釋了數字變化的原因；攻擊入口沒有確認之前，沒有急於對攻擊者身分和攻擊方式下結論；調查取得進展以後，再陸續公布第三方安全產品、零日漏洞、高權限憑證和偽造提領指令等細節。

提領恢復也是一樣。

此次事件涉及多個幣種和多條網路，排查範圍並不侷限於一個錢包。Bitget 沒有一次性恢復全部提領，而是在逐一確認相關錢包、網路和風險排除後分批開放。

9 月 26 日，平台公布了具體的恢復時間表：9 月 28 日恢復 BTC，9 月 29 日恢復 ETH 及相關網路，9 月 30 日恢復 USDT 及相關網路，其他代幣、法幣和 C2C 服務安排在 10 月 2 日恢復。發稿前已查實全部如期恢復。

 

考慮到這是一次涉及多個幣種、多條網路、第三方軟體和內部權限的大型安全事故，先給出具體到日期和時間的恢復計畫，再一項項兌現，這一點值得肯定。

保護基金提前四年準備，真正出事以後拿出來使用；管理層持續面對社群；確定的資訊及時公布，不確定的資訊不搶著下結論；恢復計畫給出明確時間，再按照時間執行。

 這一系列乾淨俐落的行動，讓許多人對 Bitget 的看法更為正面。 

事件轉折已現，資金重新淨流入

9 月 29 日 ETH 恢復提領後，鏈上很快出現了一個值得關注的變化。

 

據鏈上分析師 Ai 姨監測，Bitget 為因應 ETH 提領準備的相關熱錢包，在提領開放後的半小時內，餘額重新回到 3 萬 ETH 以上，超過初始值。

Bitget 隨後公布的數據顯示，恢復提領後的第一個小時，ETH 流入約 9,674 枚、流出約 9,023 枚，淨流入約 651 ETH。9 月 30 日數據顯示，24 小時平台資金流入金額達 2.31 億美元，與今年 8 月日均資金流入金額 2.45 億美元接近，沒有出現市場此前擔心的單向資金外流，反而能看到市場信心回暖。

與此同時，為了回饋用戶的信任，Bitget 也開始推出多項激勵活動。

 

ETH PoolX 提供 50 萬 USDT 獎池，用戶鎖倉 ETH 即可參與分配，活動早期頁面預估 APR 一度達到約 37.11%，隨後隨著參與資金增加動態回落。

BTC PoolX 隨後上線，提供 10 萬 BGB 獎池，並根據用戶此前 15 日的 BTC 持倉給予額外加成。

穩定幣方面，Bitget 同期推出 USDT 和 USDGO 活期理財活動，支援隨存隨取，限時 APR 分別達到 10% 和 12%。「同行計畫」則將活動期間符合條件的交易手續費收入的 30% 納入用戶獎池，其中 60% 按交易量分配，40% 按資產量分配。10 月 2 日，Bitget 官方數據顯示首批獎勵已發放，累計向 763,543 名用戶發放 1,907,455 USDT。

這些活動的意圖並不難理解。提領恢復解決的是用戶「能不能走」的問題，隨後推出的一系列活動，則是在重新啟動交易、理財和資金沉澱。

很快，許多用戶用資金投票，展現出對 Bitget 的信心和對活動的熱情。

 

幾天前，市場最關心的還是「錢什麼時候能提」；隨著提領恢復，問題開始變成「參加哪一項活動能獲得更高的 APR」。

事件出現轉折的訊號。

 對於交易所來說，用戶信心恢復最直接的證明，就是在可以自由出入之時仍願意把錢留下來。 

一次安全事故，給交易所產業留下了什麼

Bitget 此次事件發生後，幾乎得到了產業「半壁江山」的支持。

這裡面最值得一提的是 Bybit。

2025 年 2 月，Bybit 遭遇約 14 億美元安全事件。攻擊發生後大約 5 個小時，Bitget 向 Bybit 提供了 40,000 ETH，當時價值超過 1 億美元。這 40,000 ETH 沒有利息、沒有抵押，也沒有約定固定還款期限。Bybit 隨後在三天內全額歸還。

一年多以後，雙方的位置交換了。Bitget 出事後，Bybit CEO Ben Zhou 很快公開表示願意提供幫助，並特意提到：「我們遭遇駭客攻擊時，Bitget 曾經幫助過我們。」隨後 Bybit 將相關被盜資金納入 LazarusBounty 系統追蹤。

站出來的遠不只是 Bybit。CZ 在事件發生後公開聲援，Binance 安全團隊隨後與 Bitget 展開合作，包括共享威脅情資、追蹤被盜資金和支援資產追回；MEXC CEO Vugar Usi 也主動聯繫 Bitget 表示支持。交易所之外，Mandiant、SlowMist 參與調查和鑑識，Circle、Tether 參與相關資產凍結。

 

看到這些新聞時，我確實有些熱血沸騰。

加密產業從來不缺競爭。交易所之間爭用戶、爭流動性、爭市場占有率，但真正遇到數億美元級別的安全危機，作為同行又會抱團取暖。

 而 Bitget 作為一個平台，在產業裡有沒有真正贏得信任和尊重，到了危機時刻最為直觀。 

但這件事如果只停留在「患難見真情」，又低估了它的意義。

加密產業沒有一個統一的機構兜底，但保護基金、同行協作、安全機構和鏈上追蹤正在形成一套自己的風險處理網路。與此同時，從熱錢包、簽名系統到第三方軟體和內部權限，交易所需要防守的邊界也愈來愈大：攻擊愈來愈複雜，產業需要攜手應對。

而設立保護基金、事後保持公開透明與遵循承諾，以及產業合作，現在已經是因應危機的優良範式，Bitget 現在已經認真演示了一遍。

 

過去兩年，加密產業一直在談 Mass Adoption。ETF、穩定幣、RWA 和代幣化證券把更多傳統金融資金帶進來，美國的監管架構也在逐步建立。走到這一步，產業需要證明的已經不只是創新和成長，還有處理風險的能力。

 Bitget 這次用 4 億美元檢驗了一家平台在危機面前的責任感。危機不會終結一個平台，擔當可以重新定義一個平台。 

對正在走向主流金融的加密產業來說，這同樣是一場必須經歷的考試。沒有任何金融體系能夠建立在「永遠不出事」的假設上。真的出了事，能不能賠得起、說得清、恢復得了，考驗的則是責任和底線。

金融世界最終如何看待加密產業，可能就取決於它如何正確因應糟糕的一天。

GAEA Ventures 與 021Lab 將於 10 月 6 日在新加坡舉辦 Horizon 系列活動「Trading the AI Era」，聚焦 AI 如何改變加密貨幣交易市場。活動邀請交易者、開發者與投資人參與，包括專案分享、圓桌討論及交流酒會。圓桌主題為 AI x Trading，探討 AI Agent 在自動交易中的信任、資金管理及市場情緒分析。主辦方期望串聯 AI、交易與 Web3 領域參與者，共同探索未來三至五年的演算法驅動交易新體驗。 （前情提要：雙強活動連發：GAEA Ventures 將於東京 WebX 期間重磅打造 AI 與鏈上經濟雙主題之夜） （背景補充：求償40億美元！Terraform Labs破產管理人起訴Jump Trading：應對LUNA崩盤直接負責！） （本文為新聞稿，由 GAEA Ventures 與 021Lab 撰文、提供，不代表動區立場。） GAEA Ventures 與 021Lab 將於 10 月 6 日在新加坡舉辦 Horizon 系列活動「Trading the AI Era」。本次活動由 RootData、Origins Network、DNetwork、Hyperliquid Asian 及 Becker Ventures 共同協辦，並獲得 BTSE、ChainCatcher、Travix、1783DAO、Eden 及 SkyDAO 的支援。 活動將於當地時間 18:00 至 22:00 在 67 Ayer Rajah Crescent 舉行，邀請交易者、開發者、創業者、投資人及 Web3 產業參與者，透過專案介紹、圓桌討論、抽獎與交流活動，分享各團隊目前正在推進的產品、業務與市場方向。 根據活動議程，Becker Ventures 共同創辦人 Ric、021Lab 創辦人 Shumin、Origins Network 執行長 Carlos 與 DNA Agent 執行長 James 將依序進行分享，介紹各自團隊目前所專注的領域，以及正在布局的產品與應用。 活動後半段將以「AI x Trading: How AI Is Changing Crypto Markets」為題進行圓桌討論，由 GAEA Ventures 創辦人 Logan、Eden Labs 共同創辦人 Ming Wu、021Lab 創辦人 Shumin、Origins Network 執行長 Carlos 及 DNA Agent 執行長 James 共同參與。討論將聚焦 AI 如何實際進入加密貨幣交易流程，包括 AI Agent 從市場分析走向自動交易時的信任與資金管理問題、AI 對市場情緒與趨勢的辨識能力，以及當類似工具逐漸普及後，交易者的競爭優勢將如何改變。 圓桌論壇將深入探討鏈上資料、價格走勢、社群情緒與錢包動態在人工智慧量化交易中的核心價值，並檢視過度仰賴演算法訊號潛藏的市場風險。隨著自主交易代理人開始直接介入鏈上協議與交易市場，與會嘉賓也將剖析這類技術突破所帶來的全新機遇與潛在隱憂，進一步展望人工智慧與加密貨幣結合的長期落地應用，勾勒未來三至五年由演算法驅動的原生交易新體驗。 活動尾聲特別安排抽獎環節與交流酒會，邀請各路交易員、創業者、工程師、投資人與人工智慧開發團隊在議程之餘齊聚一堂，暢談產品構想、市場研究、實戰經驗與潛在的商務合作。 作為 Horizon 系列活動的一站，「Trading the AI Era」希望透過團隊介紹與圓桌交流，串聯關注 AI、Trading 與 Web3 的產業參與者。 報名連結：https://luma.com/egxzlyfe 主辦方 GAEA Ventures:https://x.com/GaeaVentures 021Lab:https://021lab.xyz/ 聯合主辦 RootData:https://x.com/RootDataCrypto 相關報導 Jump Trading反擊Terraform 40億鎂索賠：逃避SEC罰款，責任不該轉嫁給我們〈GAEA Ventures 與 021Lab 將於新加坡舉辦 Trading the AI Era，聚焦 AI 與加密貨幣交易市場〉這篇文章最早發佈於動區BlockTempo《動區動趨-最具影響力的區塊鏈新聞媒體》。

articles.title: 紐約時報特稿：走進億萬富翁趙長鵬的生活
articles.excerpt:
編者按：別墅裡有一處一直沒修好的漏水，天花板上留著一塊顏色不一樣的水漬；門廳裡堆著一箱箱幣安周邊，主人勸記者挑 […]

〈 紐約時報特稿：走進億萬富翁趙長鵬的生活 〉這篇文章最早發佈於動區BlockTempo《 動區動趨-最具影響力的區塊鏈新聞媒體 》。

編者按：別墅裡有一處一直沒修好的漏水，天花板上留著一塊顏色不一樣的水漬；門廳裡堆著一箱箱幣安周邊，主人勸記者挑一件帶走； （前情提要：Yala 穩定幣 $YU 開始脫錨 1 美元！USDX 爆掉翻版？官方宣布調查惹社群質疑） （背景補充：從寒冷中歸來的預言者Chainlink：讓傳統金融看懂區塊鏈） 別墅裡有一處一直沒修好的漏水，天花板上留著一塊顏色不一樣的水漬；門廳裡堆著一箱箱幣安周邊，主人勸記者挑一件帶走；家裡那架施坦威鋼琴擺在遊戲室正中，調音師上門，才發現從來沒人彈過。 這是《紐約時報》筆下趙長鵬在阿布達比的日常。 他開著白色日產 SUV，把 iPhone 架在擋風玻璃上，自嘲像「全世界最有錢的優步司機」；吉爾吉斯總統送給他一隻泰幹犬，另一隻狗則被他取名「西蘭花」，因為聽起來有點像「區塊鏈」。他也談起監獄裡的日子：和銀行劫匪聊商業，回答獄友「比特幣為什麼漲」，甚至組織了一個追蹤股價的學習小組。 這些細節拼出了一個頗為矛盾的趙長鵬：一邊，他不斷強調自己只是一個普通、甚至有些樸素的「技術男」；另一邊，他已經置身於由王室、主權基金、政府和全球資本構成的權力網路。即使經歷認罪、入獄和退出幣安管理層，他在加密產業的影響力並沒有真正消失。 這篇文章有意思的地方，正在於兩種形象的並置。趙長鵬把自己講成一個稀裡糊塗捲進大事的局外人，而文中的另一條線索卻顯示，他每一步都走得相當精明：選擇在哪裡落腳，選擇與誰結盟，也選擇怎樣講述自己。幣安早年的增長，靠的是在監管的縫隙裡生存；今天的趙長鵬，已經直接坐到了政府、主權資本和政治家族之間。 在這個意義上，他的故事也是加密產業過去十年的縮影：從草莽增長，到被納入監管，再到與政治和國家資本深度繫結。生活裡的那些小細節，或許是理解這個故事最輕鬆的入口，但它們背後真正值得追問的是：一個經歷過認罪和監禁的人，為什麼依然坐在牌桌中央？ 六月的一個早晨，加密貨幣大亨趙長鵬開著一輛白色日產 SUV，來到阿布達比的瑞吉度假酒店。趙長鵬是加密貨幣界的首富，身家估計達 1140 億美元，就住在附近一棟別墅裡：九個臥室、四名保鏢、一名廚師，還有一艘名叫「Da Moon」的遊艇。但他也喜歡扮演他常用來形容自己的那種「普通人」，那天他主動提出，要親自帶我逛一逛這座城市。在瑞吉酒店門外，趙長鵬坐在日產車的駕駛座上，iPhone 架在擋風玻璃上，活像全世界最有錢的優步司機。「這是我的蘭博基尼，」我上車時他開玩笑說。 說清楚一點：趙長鵬不是普通人。不久前，美國當局針對他管理幣安（Binance）的方式提起刑事訴訟；在法庭檔案中，這家加密貨幣交易所被描述為俄羅斯洗錢者、逃避伊朗制裁者和伊斯蘭國恐怖分子的避風港。趙長鵬認了罪，財富卻毫髮無損。服完四個月刑期後，他回到阿布達比，依然是幣安的大股東，依然是這個產業裡最有權勢的人物。 如今 49 歲的趙長鵬，出入世界的方式像一位國家元首：乘私人飛機穿梭亞洲，為各國政府提供加密貨幣監管方面的建議；他每在伊斯蘭堡或馬尼拉停留一次，隨後往往就會傳出幣安在監管上取得新突破的訊息。在他家裡，兩隻狗中有一只是泰幹犬（Taigan），一種優雅的中亞獵犬，常被比作羚羊。它是吉爾吉斯總統送的禮物，這位對加密貨幣頗感興趣的總統還在二月和他一起滑過雪。「他本來想送我一隻帳篷，就是那種大號的帳篷，」趙長鵬說，「我說不要帳篷，他就非要送狗。」 趙長鵬最有影響力的盟友，是兩個權勢顯赫的統治家族。一個是執掌阿拉伯聯合大公國的家族，他們希望借他之力，在沙漠中打造一個科技強國。另一個是川普家族。去年，幣安與 World Liberty Financial 建立了業務關係，這家加密貨幣初創公司由川普總統和他的三個兒子創辦。去年，World Liberty 為川普帶來了 7.99 億美元收入，是他最賺錢的單項資產，比他的房地產組合或社交媒體生意都更來錢。去年 10 月，川普特赦了趙長鵬，此舉被廣泛批評為利益交換。 在業內被稱作「CZ」的趙長鵬通常回避記者，但今年他與我見了好幾次面，急著為自己在幣安的生涯刷上一層更友好的光澤，儘管幣安至今仍未堵住髒錢的流動。他高而瘦，黑色短髮，小臂上有一個幣安紋身，沒有許多加密貨幣同行身上那種兄弟會式的張揚。他給人的印象是禮貌而專注，儘管他的興趣窄得近乎滑稽。今年，他自費出版了回憶錄《貨幣自由》（Freedom of Money），書中寫到有人帶他在閉館後參觀盧浮宮。這段經歷讓他毫無感覺。他寫道，那個嚮導無異於在「對牛彈琴」。 多年來，他真正的天職是學者們所說的「司法管轄區套利」，也就是在一個又一個國家之間輾轉，尋找一套足夠柔軟、能容納他對風險與增長的胃口的法律框架。在阿布達比，他或許找到了理想的落腳點。我們驅車進城，趙長鵬和藹地閒聊，中途停下來讓保鏢幫忙看路。（「好的老闆，靠右。」）我們經過一片氣派的宅邸，朝總統府 Qasr Al Watan 駛去，它那醒目的白色穹頂讓人想起泰姬陵。 趙長鵬越說越起勁。「過去幾百年，民主一直被奉為聖盃，但民主效率低下，」快到總統府時他說，「如果遇上一位仁慈的 dictator，效率其實極高。沒什麼爭論，不會把時間浪費在那些無聊的事情上。」 近來，這種既中世紀又超現代的、自上而下的商業與政治模式，在美國越來越有市場。去年訪問阿布達比時，川普稱該國統治者 Sheikh Mohammed bin Zayed Al Nahyan 是「一個非常強硬的人」，是「少有的有遠見的人」。Zach Witkoff 是川普一位高階顧問的兒子，本身也算得上 MAGA 圈的王孫，去年 5 月在杜拜的一場加密貨幣大會上說得更直白。「我們真該學學殿下和阿聯的做法，」Mr. Witkoff 說，「他們是一個了不起的範例，展示瞭如何既引領創新，又守住家庭價值觀。」 趙長鵬已經生活在這群人嚮往的未來裡，安身於一個君主與億萬富翁和諧共處的精英飛地。駛離總統府時，他跟我講起自己此前在附近酋長國宮殿文華東方酒店參加的一場私人會議，與會者包括避險基金創始人 Ray Dal...〈紐約時報特稿：走進億萬富翁趙長鵬的生活〉這篇文章最早發佈於動區BlockTempo《動區動趨-最具影響力的區塊鏈新聞媒體》。

articles.title: Mastercard’s Ben Gilbey on Premium Cards Built on Experiences
articles.excerpt:
Mastercard's Ben Gilbey explains why issuers in Asia Pacific are building premium card propositions around dining and travel rather than points and cashback.

The post Mastercard’s Ben Gilbey on Premium Cards Built on Experiences appeared first on The Fintech Times .

Premium card propositions were long built on points, cashback and lounge access. Issuers now have to compete on something harder to copy, and Mastercard is betting that the answer is curated experiences that travel with the cardholder. 

 Ben Gilbey, SVP, consumer products & processing, Asia Pacific, Mastercard 

In August the network opened Asia Pacific’s first Taste by Priceless dining club at Hong Kong International Airport, part of The Mastercard Collection, following the first at São Paulo’s Guarulhos airport. Ben Gilbey , senior vice president, consumer products and processing, Asia Pacific, at Mastercard, spoke to The Fintech Times about what the launch says about premium cards and what issuers are asking for.

 From rewarding spend to creating relevance 

“Premium is becoming more experiential and personal,” Gilbey said. “While traditional card benefits still matter, consumers increasingly value access to experiences that reflect their interests and lifestyles.” He cited Mastercard research finding that 59 per cent of high-net-worth individuals prefer spending on experiences over possessions.

For issuers, he argues, that changes where premium value comes from. “Historically, premium propositions were built around rewarding transactions. Today, the opportunity is to help cardholders pursue the things they care about most.”

He does not suggest points and cashback are finished. “The question is not whether experiences replace those benefits, but how premium propositions evolve beyond them,” he said. “As rewards become common across the market, issuers are looking for ways to create differentiation that extends beyond transactional value.” Mastercard research, he added, found that nearly three in four consumers feel their best when spending time on their passions. “For issuers, this shifts the conversation from rewarding spend to creating relevance.”

 Why the airport 

Gilbey pointed to Mastercard’s 2026 Travel Trendlines research, which found travellers placing more emphasis on making each trip meaningful and personal, and so on benefits built into the journey rather than bolted on. Dining, he said, “is one of the most authentic ways to experience a destination’s culture, creativity and identity, while also being a naturally social and memorable part of travel. In Asia Pacific, where travel and food consistently rank among consumers’ strongest passions, the connection is even stronger.”

On location, the network looks for places “that sit at the intersection of traveler demand, international connectivity and strong local identity.” Hong Kong International Airport met the first two as a regional gateway, and the city’s food culture met the third. A third club is due to open in Mexico City later this year.

 No single premium traveller 

Personalisation runs through Gilbey’s answers. “There is no longer a single definition of a premium traveler,” he said. Mastercard Economics Institute data he cited shows Singaporean travellers to Japan allocate 38 per cent of their in-destination spending to retail, while South Korean visitors spend 45 per cent more at bars than the average traveller to Japan.

“For financial institutions, the opportunity is not simply to provide access, but to provide meaningful choice while maintaining a consistently high standard of quality and service,” he said. The Hong Kong venue offers two formats as a result: The Counter, a chef-led, multi-course tasting, and The Cove, a more relaxed à la carte setting for travellers with less time.

 What issuers are asking for 

The Mastercard Collection is the network’s global portfolio of dining, entertainment and travel experiences. In Asia Pacific it includes access to more than 400 award-winning restaurants across 10 markets. “What we’re hearing from issuers is a growing demand for benefits that reflect international lifestyles,” Gilbey said. Cardholders are travelling more often and spending across markets, so issuers want “premium value that can travel with their customers.”

The Hong Kong club is open to World Legend, World Elite and World Mastercard cardholders regardless of where the card was issued. “That balance between consistency and authenticity is an important differentiator in the premium segment,” he said.

 Curation over accumulation 

Looking ahead, Gilbey expects premium value “to become increasingly centered on curation rather than accumulation. Consumers already have more rewards programs, offers and choice than ever before. The challenge is no longer access alone, but helping people identify the experiences that are genuinely worth their time and attention.”

“For issuers, that raises a different question: not how many benefits they can offer, but how relevant those benefits are,” he said. Taste by Priceless in Mexico City is slated to open later this year.

The post Mastercard’s Ben Gilbey on Premium Cards Built on Experiences appeared first on The Fintech Times .

articles.title: Japan’s population is shrinking at an accelerating rate, but the nationalist prime minister is making it harder for foreigners to live there
articles.excerpt:
The latest five-year census showed the number of Japanese nationals declined by 3.5% to 119.1 million in 2025, following a 1.4% drop in the 2020 count.

New census data over the past week showed Japan’s population shrank more quickly than in the prior tally. Also last week, the government rolled out tougher rules for foreign nationals who want to live in Japan.

While foreigners make up just 3.4% of Japan’s population, the share has increased to a record high and a political backlash has been building—even as the country also grapples with rapidly aging demographics and the need to find new workers to sustain economic growth.

On Tuesday, the latest five-year population survey detailed how stark Japan’s situation is. As of October 2025, the total population, including foreign residents, was 22.9 million, down 2.5% from five years earlier. The prior census in 2020 showed a dip of 0.7%.

The number of Japanese nationals revealed an even steeper decline of 3.5% to 119.1 million, following a 1.4% drop in the 2020 count. 

Meanwhile, foreign residents jumped 40% to a record high of 3.84 million, and permanent residents climbed 17% to 947,125.

Like other wealthy economies in Asia, Japan’s birth rate has been below the replacement level of 2.1 children per woman for decades, and the population has been in steady decline since around 2008.

At the same time, Japan is aging, and the percentage of people age 65 and older rose to 29.4% in 2025 from 28.5% in 2020. In fact, adult diapers have been outselling baby diapers since 2011.

The country is scrambling to find ways to encourage people to have more kids. For example, Tokyo’s metropolitan government launched a dating app to bring more couples together.

Tokyo also started a four-day workweek and partial leave policy for city workers to help those who are parents balance childcare and work.

By contrast, policies have turned more hostile when it comes to foreigners. 

On Thursday, the Japanese government increased fees for permanent residency to $1,271 from $64 — a 2,000% jump that marks the largest increase in the country’s history. The cost for a five-year residence permit shot up to $475 from $38.

Japan also imposed more detailed requirements on income for permanent residents, who must now earn a minimum of $36,428 per year. And for the first time, applicants for permanent residency will be evaluated based on their Japanese language skills as well as their grasp of rules and customs.

On top of that, the government can revoke permanent residency for not meeting pension contribution obligations, failing to pay health insurance and taxes, and violating immigration law or the penal code.

The changes come as Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi has ushered in a more nationalist, right-wing stance. 

On the global stage, that has meant taking a harder line against rivals like China and North Korea, while also bulking up Japan’s military.

Domestically, the pivot has translated to a crackdown on immigration and even tourism, drawing criticism that Takaichi is encouraging xenophobia. In July, the government hiked some tourist visa prices by more than 400%. 

In a post on X ahead of the government’s new residency rules, Takaichi said many permanent residents could not maintain independent livelihoods.

“The government recognizes that, with the increasing number of foreign residents, there are citizens who feel anxiety and a sense of unfairness, and is addressing this by making ‘foreign policy’ more ‘orderly’ so that both citizens and foreigners can live safely and securely,” she wrote.

This story was originally featured on Fortune.com

第三方外送平台改變了披薩產業的消費習慣，也讓原本擁有直面消費者優勢的速食品牌，開始面臨顧客關係與利潤空間被中間平台切割的問題。美國速食披薩品牌 Papa Johns 上季同店銷售下滑超過 8%，伴隨關店與營運調整，促使品牌展開全面性的數位轉型。

Papa Johns 數位與科技長 Kevin Vasconi 指出，Papa Johns 雖有高達 85% 業務來自數位管道，但核心系統已嚴重老化，改革的關鍵在於重構底層科技，從根本改善門市營運與顧客下單體驗。

告別 30 年老舊 POS，串聯數據賦能營運精準決策

轉型的第一步，是淘汰運作長達 30 年的自研 POS 系統。舊系統結構僵化，難以因應現代速食業頻繁更迭的促銷、價格調整與限時優惠需求。Papa Johns 攜手 PAR Technology 於數千間門市導入新世代 POS 系統。新系統改採類 App 的直覺化圖形介面，取代傳統繁雜的文字排版，不僅能清晰呈現備餐流程與訂單資訊，大幅降低門市員工的培訓門檻與操作失誤，更透過數千間門市的操作優化，為品牌帶來龐大的累積營運效益。

更換 POS 的背後，更重要的戰略意圖在於數據的全面整合。Papa Johns 雖然累積了 30 年的顧客與交易資料，但過去多處於單點孤島狀態。PAR Technology 執行長 Savneet Singh 提出「串聯數據（Connected Data）」的概念：若單看銷售額成長，卻忽視毛利率下滑，容易做出錯誤決策；只有將銷售、毛利的財務指標，與庫存、人力排班及訂單流向等營運數據進行跨系統串聯，才能還原營運全貌。Papa Johns 透過串聯數據，將龐雜資料轉化為可即時調用的決策依據，精準賦能門市管理者與第一線員工。

雙端 AI 應用：精準排班與智慧點餐助手

在健全的數據基礎之上，AI 成為提升效率與體驗的關鍵引擎。在內部營運端，門市經理利用 AI 預測銷售趨勢，動態優化人力排班，填補人力缺口並控制成本。在消費者端，Papa Johns 與 Google 合作推出多模態 AI 點餐助手「Lou AI」，專門解決高摩擦力的點餐情境。Lou AI 能以人性化對話引導顧客處理複雜的團體訂單，自動評估餐點數量、避開過敏原，並智慧搜尋最適用的優惠碼與忠誠度點數折抵，讓點餐過程更加輕鬆流暢。

展望未來，Papa Johns 的 AI 布局將延伸至個人化行銷與通路重構。傳統針對數十萬人的泛用型促銷推播將被淘汰，轉而朝向「一對一」的專屬優惠設計。更重要的是，隨著 AI 代理（AI Agents）進入手機、智慧電視與車載系統，消費者未來能直接向品牌下單。這種直連管道能協助 Papa Johns 完整掌握消費者偏好數據、重建與顧客的直接關係，同時擺脫對第三方外送平台的過度依賴，大幅降低平台抽成費用。

【科技早餐】今天精選 7 則國內外重要科技新聞。

＊AI 代理私訊存取惹爭議，蘋果將收緊 Mac 完整磁碟授權

蘋果（Apple）10 月 2 日宣布，將為 macOS 的「完整磁碟存取權」（Full Disk Access）增加控制措施，要求使用者透過更明確的操作才能授權。該功能原本支援備份程式，可略過多項資料保護限制，接觸檔案、郵件、訊息與瀏覽紀錄。蘋果指出，部分開發者的使用方式，可能讓使用者未充分理解便暴露資料；隨 AI 代理能力與自主性提高，這類廣泛權限的風險將擴大，通訊對象的隱私也可能受到影響。

《路透社》報導，Meta 的 AI 代理 Muse 能替使用者取消未使用的訂閱、與業者議價，將 AI 的應用延伸至代辦任務。科技專欄作家 Jason Aten 近期指控，Muse 讀取他的 Mac 私人訊息，並稱未開啟完整磁碟權限。Meta 否認未經授權存取，表示須同時啟用完整磁碟權限與訊息連接功能，才能讀取訊息，授權亦可撤銷。蘋果未在公告點名特定產品，也未公布新措施的實作細節與上線日期；此次調整聚焦於應用程式取得資料存取權限的授權方式。

＊博通最高 420 億美元融資挺 Anthropic，晶片供應商兼任金主

《路透社》取得的 Anthropic 上市公開說明書顯示，博通（Broadcom）同意提供最高 420 億美元融資，支持該公司的基礎設施支出。Anthropic 已承諾支付 1,252 億美元，租用五年 TPU 算力，這項額度若全數動用，可支應約三分之一的租賃承諾。相關債務可轉換為 Anthropic 股份，博通也能指定融資合作方；Anthropic 預期上市完成前不會出售相關融資票據；報導指出，該公司預計 2027 年成為博通最大的算力客戶。

博通同時參與算力供應、設備租賃與融資，Anthropic 因此在公開說明書揭露潛在利益衝突，指出硬體定價及供應決策可能影響算力取得。特定付款或履約違約，也可能使大筆租賃款立即到期，並限制融資額度的使用。另據《彭博》10 月 2 日報導，博通相關銀行團正籌組 600 億美元 AI 晶片融資，受益對象包含 Anthropic 與其他公司，但交易尚未正式宣布。晶片供應商與客戶的合作，正進一步涵蓋設備支出及資金籌措。

＊Google AI 晶片上太空，原型衛星入軌測試輻射與散熱

Google 10 月 1 日宣布，與衛星業者 Planet 合作打造的 Project Suncatcher 原型衛星，已搭乘太空探索科技公司（SpaceX）的 Transporter-18 共乘任務進入軌道。團隊已與衛星取得聯繫，並表示初步運作符合預期。該任務從美國加州范登堡太空軍基地發射，共搭載 130 個酬載，Google 的實驗衛星是其中之一。

Google 表示，接下來幾週將蒐集 TPU（Google 開發的 AI 運算晶片）在軌道上的運作資料，研究太空飛行的物理衝擊，以及太空輻射、極端溫度對晶片的影響，再據此修正設計。《Space.com》指出，晶片耐輻射能力與運算產生熱能的散熱效率，是重要驗證項目。Google 將整項計畫定位為長期研究，探索太空能否承載可擴充的機器學習基礎設施，目前尚未公布本次測試的完整結果、商用時程或成本效益結論。

＊日立、FANUC 推進實體 AI，先驗證零件抓取與產線切換

日立（Hitachi）與發那科（FANUC）9 月 30 日宣布策略合作，將結合日立的 AI、製造與生產線工程經驗，以及 FANUC 的工業機器人、控制及 AI 技術，推進實體 AI 的共同驗證與商業部署。初期使用日立位於日本茨城的製造設施，讓 AI 從實際生產資料中學習現場規則，鎖定不同形狀零件的抓取，以及切換生產品項時的產線調整。雙方將評估辨識準確度、機器人動作、生產節拍與生產品質，並測試日立邊緣 AI 晶片與機器人的整合。

根據雙方公告，兩家公司規劃自 2027 會計年度起，利用全球客戶基礎部署相關方案，涵蓋半導體、製藥、醫療、汽車、物流、食品及造船等產業。雙方指出，零件處理與生產切換等任務，仍需要工人依現場變化做判斷；合作希望讓機器人學習這些經驗，回應缺工與技術傳承需求。目前公布的是合作、驗證項目與推廣時程，尚未公布完整測試結果或這項合作帶來的量化生產效益。驗證也將涵蓋產線與整座工廠的彈性運作。

＊AI 有成效卻難全面落地，調查點出法規與舊系統障礙

顧問公司 BearingPoint 10 月 1 日公布調查，今年 8 月透過線上訪問，蒐集歐洲、美國與中國等 13 國共 1,050 名高階主管回覆，樣本包含公部門與私人組織。已導入 AI 的受訪組織中，接近四分之三回報營收或成本出現可衡量的改善。在已落地 AI、尚未深入多數營運流程的組織中，僅 6% 按原定計畫完整擴大部署；AI 已深入多數營運流程的組織，這個比例接近一半，顯示不同導入程度的部署結果存在落差。

官方資料顯示，在已導入 AI 的 685 個組織中，24% 回報成本降低至少 10%，營收或服務交付改善達同等幅度的比例為 4%。調查將複雜法規列為主要障礙，其次是既有系統及流程整合；54% 的主管將高品質、可信任的資料列為擴大部署的關鍵。調查指出，許多組織等應用產生成效後，才處理架構、治理、資料整合、責任歸屬及營運模式等擴充要求。BearingPoint 將挑戰歸納為組織整合，而非單靠增加投資。以上屬受訪主管回報，並非對所有企業的成效普查。

＊GMI Cloud 完成 140.5 億元聯貸，14 家台資銀行支持 GPU 融資

中國信託銀行（CTBC Bank）與 GMI Cloud 10 月 1 日宣布，完成新台幣 140.5 億元、約 4.45 億美元的聯合授信案，共有 14 家台資銀行參與，超額認購約 2.5 倍。中信銀擔任獨家統籌、主辦及管理銀行，表示募集資金將用於 AI 工廠建置，支援大規模模型訓練與推論。GMI Cloud 的輝達（NVIDIA）GB300 NVL72 集群，已取得 NVIDIA Exemplar Cloud 資格認可。

據《中央社》及《經濟日報》，中信銀稱此案為台灣首宗全案由商業銀行團支持的 GPU 融資聯貸。銀行評估涵蓋合約現金流、營運能力、設備維護、保險與還款結構；GPU 資本支出高、技術迭代快及估值不易，使授信模式不同於傳統設備。中信銀表示，此案協助銀行建立可評估及複製的融資模式，金融服務也由硬體供應鏈延伸至算力營運。

＊AWS 停用資料中心政府保密協議，擬五年追加逾 10 億美元社區投資

亞馬遜（Amazon）旗下 AWS 執行長 Matt Garman 10 月 2 日表示，資料中心專案已不再與合作政府機關使用保密協議，並宣布 Built Together 計畫，預計五年內追加逾 10 億美元，投入美國資料中心所在社區的教育、職業訓練、能源負擔與水資源等項目。公司表示，將與當地組織合作，讓社區參與資金用途決定；教育計畫以五年內協助逾 30 萬名學生取得免費學位教育機會為目標。

AWS 同時承諾，每年公開能源與水資源使用、效率及無碳能源占比，並與電力業者及主管機關協調基礎設施費用。《Data Center Dynamics》報導，此舉發生在美國國會針對資料中心保密協議展開調查之後。資料中心擴張的溝通焦點，已延伸至地方政府資訊公開、資源使用與社區回饋。

articles.title: ether.fi Targets $500m Lending Capacity with Aave and Optimism Tie-up
articles.excerpt:
The crypto card issuer will deploy a dedicated Aave V4 lending instance on OP Mainnet, scaling from $22m borrowed today to $500m by 2027.

The post ether.fi Targets $500m Lending Capacity with Aave and Optimism Tie-up appeared first on The Fintech Times .

ether.fi entered into a three-way infrastructure partnership with decentralised lending protocol Aave and layer-2 network Optimism to expand the borrowing capacity underpinning its ether.fi Cash Visa card. The company says it will deploy a dedicated Aave V4 lending instance on Optimism’s OP Mainnet, targeting $500 million in lending capacity by 2027, up from approximately $22 million currently outstanding across its cardholder base. 

The move is presented as a response to outgrowing in-house credit infrastructure. ether.fi Cash, which launched in partnership with Visa in 2024, now counts 100,000 active cardholders across 300,000 registered accounts, a scale the company says has made bespoke lending architecture necessary rather than optional.

 How the infrastructure stack works 

The technical arrangement assigns a specific role to each partner. Aave V4 provides a single lending market capable of accepting a wide range of collateral types held by cardholders: Ethereum derivatives, wrapped Bitcoin, stablecoins, platform tokens and vault receipts. Crucially, Aave V4 issues risk parameters on a per-asset basis within that unified market, which matters when collateral quality varies as widely as it does across a retail crypto user base.

Optimism’s OP Mainnet supplies the execution layer. The rationale is latency and cost: consumer card spending demands near-instant settlement at a price point that is commercially viable for sub-hundred-dollar transactions, conditions that Optimism’s rollup architecture is intended to meet.

 Mike Silagadze , founder and chief executive of ether.fi, framed the ambition broadly. “Aave and Optimism are the right partners to help us scale from tens of millions to half a billion dollars in lending capacity. This partnership is about making it possible for anyone holding digital assets to use them like real financial capital, without ever having to sell,” he said.

 Dan Roesbery, vice president of global crypto partnerships at Visa, noted that ether.fi Cash was helping bridge on-chain capital with everyday spending, though the statement did not add commercial detail to that claim.

 Market context and competitive read-across 

The announcement lands against a backdrop of accelerating crypto card volume. According to data cited in the release from research firm Artemis , monthly crypto card spending rose from around $100 million in early 2023 to more than $1.5 billion by late 2025. Separate data from a16z and Paymentscan put July 2026 global crypto card spending at $759 million across roughly nine million transactions, approximately 2.5 times the $306 million recorded in July 2025. Optimism is reported to account for around 29% of that volume, ahead of Solana and Base, which each carry approximately 19%.

The credit-against-crypto model that ether.fi Cash uses sits in a structurally interesting position in the payments landscape. It competes not only with other crypto card issuers but, more broadly, with collateralised lending products offered by centralised exchanges and with the emerging cohort of DeFi-native credit facilities. The distinction ether.fi stresses is non-custodial ownership: cardholders are said to retain full ownership of their digital assets while drawing credit against them, which removes the counterparty risk present in exchange-based borrowing but introduces smart contract risk in its place.

For Optimism, the partnership is the latest in a series of institutional infrastructure deals. The network recently signed an MOU with South Korean fintech Toss to pilot a won-backed stablecoin, and has agreements covering Bitpanda ‘s Vision Chain and Mitsui and Co .’s tokenised metals platform, Zipangcoin. Each deal reinforces Optimism’s positioning as a managed infrastructure provider for regulated and semi-regulated financial use cases rather than a purely retail-speculative chain.

The key milestones to watch are whether the $500 million lending capacity target is reached on schedule, which collateral types prove most popular in practice, and how the arrangement is treated by regulators as crypto card products draw increasing attention from payments supervisors in both the UK and the EU under evolving digital assets frameworks.

The post ether.fi Targets $500m Lending Capacity with Aave and Optimism Tie-up appeared first on The Fintech Times .

articles.title: 4 Cryptocurrencies to Watch This Week: BTC, HYPE, ZEC, and KAS Face Crucial Tests
articles.excerpt:
BTC, HYPE, ZEC, and KAS are set to begin the new week with very different setups, but all four are approaching important technical or fundamental milestones.

Bitcoin entered its most successful month with a bang, surging past $87,000 on Friday after the release of the weak US jobs report. Institutional demand has improved significantly over the past few months.

Meanwhile, Hyperliquid, Zcash, and Kaspa each have important protocol or market catalysts in play. Here are the key levels and developments to watch.

BTC: This Level Remains Key

Softer US inflation data, strong institutional demand, and the weaker-than-expected jobs report on Friday helped BTC recover some of the recent losses, with the asset challenging the key $87,000 resistance once again at the end of the business week.

The latest PCE data showed core inflation rising 0.2% month-over-month and around 3.0% annually, both of which were below expectations. That, alongside the relatively small number of only 29,000 added jobs in September, reduced some concerns about the need for additional monetary tightening from the US Federal Reserve.

The setup, though, is not entirely bullish. Glassnode recently cited data showing relatively limited profit-taking compared with previous market tops, but selling by long-term holders has recently increased. Trading volumes remain comparatively weak, suggesting BTC may need stronger buyer participation before confirming another major leg up.

The $87,000-$87,500 resistance remains the first notable obstacle in bitcoin’s path, as a decisive break above it could open the door toward the next big selling zone at around $95,000.

Hyperliquid’s Case

Hyperliquid’s native token has been among the strongest market performers lately, reaching consecutive all-time highs as protocol activity and ecosystem development continue to expand. One of those was the introduction of manual borrowing through HyperCore. Since September 18, users have been able to use HYPE and BTC as collateral to borrow USDC or USDT, with borrowing volume reaching almost $270 million on the first day.

The project has also introduced trailing-stop orders for perpetual markets, while its tokenomics continue to generate persistent buy-side pressure. 99% of platform fees are directed toward the Assistance Fund to repurchase HYPE from the open market.

From a technical perspective, the next important question is whether the $90-$92 region can turn into sustained support. If it does, the bullish structure remains intact. In contrast, $85 could serve as the first major support in case of a pullback.

Zcash: Privacy Meets Network Upgrade

When we talk about massive price gainers, it’s difficult to leave ZEC out of the conversation. It has been frequently posting major gains, up by over 1,000% in the past year or so, and recently topped $1,600 for the first time in a decade.

The biggest development is the network’s seventh major upgrade, which received overwhelming support from voters and is scheduled to activate on November 5. It will reduce block time from 75 seconds to 25, effectively tripling the rate of block production. Participants also voted to retain Zcash’s existing halving structure, which resembles Bitcoin’s issuance model.

Another notable metric is the amount of ZEC held in shielded pools, as recent updates on the matter indicated that 29% of the existing supply is currently shielded. Another 4 million tokens have moved into the newer Ironwood pool.

Kaspa: Adoption Being Tested

Kaspa’s recent developments have focused more heavily on expanding what developers can actually build on the network, such as the Tokata hard fork. It introduced UTXOs, covenants, transaction introspection, and native zero-knowledge verification, pushing the project beyond its original role as a high-throughput proof-of-work payments network.

Released in September, Silverscript 1.0 added higher-level tools for building covenant logic, including vaults, escrow, mechanisms, and time locks. The .k name service also launched during the same month, allowing Kaspa addresses to be replaced by readable names, with several thousand registrations recorded within the first few days.

In terms of price movements, KAS has soared by roughly 50% in the past month, bringing the psychological $0.50 level back into focus. The question now is whether the network usage can catch up with the technological development.

The post 4 Cryptocurrencies to Watch This Week: BTC, HYPE, ZEC, and KAS Face Crucial Tests appeared first on CryptoPotato .

articles.title: Tribe Payments Joins EWPN to Back Women’s Progression in Paytech
articles.excerpt:
The global payments processor has signed a year-long Silver sponsorship with the European Women Payments Network, anchored by a Lithuania community push.

The post Tribe Payments Joins EWPN to Back Women’s Progression in Paytech appeared first on The Fintech Times .

Tribe Payments has entered a year-long partnership with the European Women Payments Network (EWPN) , a pan-European not-for-profit representing women across payments, fintech and financial services. The arrangement includes Silver sponsorship of EWPN’s 2026 Annual Conference, scheduled for 2 and 3 November, and dedicated support for the network’s growing community in Lithuania. 

 Ruta Kairyte, commercial director for Northern Europe at Tribe Payments 

The Lithuanian thread is the more operationally grounded part of the deal. Rūta Kairytė , Tribe’s commercial director for Northern Europe, was appointed EWPN Country Ambassador for Lithuania earlier this year and has already hosted the country’s first EWPN meet-up at Tribe’s Kaunas office. The Kaunas hub is Tribe’s largest office and engineering base, with more than 150 employees. Kairytė has over 15 years of experience in fintech and payments, including more than nine years at Tribe, where she has held roles spanning managing director of the Lithuanian operation, head of product delivery, and her current commercial brief across the Baltics and Nordics.

Kairytė said Lithuania’s payments sector has built a strong international standing, but that female representation still drops sharply at executive level. “We still see the numbers fall away as you move into executive positions and roles with real decision-making power,” she said. “Women also need access to the networks, opportunities and experience that help them move into positions of influence.”

 The numbers behind the initiative 

 Blayne Pereira, head of marketing at Tribe Payments 

The European Institute for Gender Equality’s 2025 Gender Equality Index found that women hold 28% of board positions at Lithuania’s largest listed companies, up three percentage points since 2023 but still short of three in ten seats. That figure provides the structural backdrop for the EWPN’s community-building work in the country, which Kairytė said will focus on practical conversations: pay negotiation, stepping into leadership roles, and returning to work after parental leave.

 Blayne Pereira , head of marketing at Tribe Payments, framed the corporate partnership in terms of broader inclusion, citing EWPN’s track record of platforming causes beyond gender, including disability inclusion through Project Nemo at its 2024 conference.

 Market context 

 Nadia Edwards-Dashti, executive board member of EWPN 

Corporate sponsorship of diversity networks in financial services has become a standard part of employer-brand strategy at paytech and banking firms. What distinguishes the Tribe arrangement is its regional specificity. Lithuania has emerged over the past decade as one of Europe’s more active fintech licensing hubs, partly through the Bank of Lithuania ‘s relatively accessible regulatory framework, which attracted a cluster of e-money and payment institution licence holders following the post-Brexit redistribution of EU passporting. That concentration of activity makes representation at senior level a more pointed question: if a jurisdiction is marketing itself as a fintech centre, the composition of its decision-making layer matters to the talent pipeline.

Tribe describes itself as Europe’s only processor with simultaneous connectivity to Mastercard , Visa , American Express , UnionPay International , Discover and JCB through a single integration, a claim it uses to position its platform as a consolidation point for issuers and acquirers operating across card schemes. The Kaunas office’s scale suggests the company has a material stake in Lithuania’s talent market, which gives the EWPN partnership a commercial rationale alongside the stated inclusion goals.

 Nadia Edwards-Dashti , executive board member of EWPN, said the partnership would help build connections between Lithuania’s payments community and the broader European network. The next visible milestone will be the EWPN Annual Conference in November, where Tribe’s Silver sponsorship will be activated.

The post Tribe Payments Joins EWPN to Back Women’s Progression in Paytech appeared first on The Fintech Times .

articles.title: UN:BLOCK Fintech Conference to Convene 600 Leaders in Riga
articles.excerpt:
The one-day Riga forum on 15 October will address MiCA licensing, PSD3, agentic payments and Latvia's emerging role as a European fintech hub.

The post UN:BLOCK Fintech Conference to Convene 600 Leaders in Riga appeared first on The Fintech Times .

UN:BLOCK Fintech , a new one-day conference organised by the team behind the annual UN:BLOCK Europe blockchain event, will take place on 15 October 2026 at Fantadroms in Riga. The organisers expect more than 600 attendees, including founders, institutional investors, retail investors and EU regulatory representatives. 

The programme spans keynotes and panel discussions on the main stage alongside a set of practitioner-level workshops. Thematic coverage includes agentic payments and AI-driven commerce, MiCA licensing and stablecoin regulation, the Digital Operational Resilience Act (DORA), the revised Payment Services Directive (PSD3), network tokenisation, digital identity, cybersecurity and crowdfunding. Named participants include mobility technology company Bolt , crowdfunding platform Digilo and conference partner Magnetiq Bank .

 Workshop track and regulatory access 

The workshop strand is notable for its direct regulatory access. Sessions will cover anti-money laundering and MLRO compliance, a step-by-step licensing guide covering MiCA, electronic money institution, payment institution and crowdfunding service provider authorisations, and a regulatory sandbox session with Latvijas Banka. A live compliance clinic with bookable advisory slots is also planned. For smaller firms and early-stage founders seeking EU authorisation, this format offers a more structured on-ramp than a standard conference floor.

 Reinis Znotiņš , Executive Director of the Latvian Blockchain Association , said: “Northern Europe’s fintech scene continues to grow, attracting increasing interest from businesses and retail investors alike. We believe the UN:BLOCK Fintech Forum will create valuable opportunities for business development, while giving private investors the chance to explore emerging sectors, innovative financial products, and compelling new investment opportunities.” The Latvian Blockchain Association co-organised the event, which also received co-financing from the European Regional Development Fund and the Latvian state budget.

 Latvia’s regulatory positioning 

Latvia’s pitch as a fintech and crypto gateway into Europe is the underlying commercial rationale for holding the conference in Riga rather than a larger hub. The country allows company share capital to be paid in cryptocurrency, a relatively unusual provision in the EU, and Latvijas Banka has maintained an active regulatory sandbox. For companies targeting EU passporting rights, smaller jurisdictions with pragmatic supervisors can offer a faster path to authorisation than regulators in Frankfurt, Paris or Amsterdam, though the trade-off is a narrower domestic market and a talent pool that requires active investment to maintain.

This positions Riga alongside Vilnius and Tallinn as a Baltic contender for fintech registration and licensing activity. The Baltic corridor has attracted significant regulatory arbitrage over the past several years, with Lithuanian e-money licences in particular drawing UK-exited firms post-Brexit. Latvia’s digital-asset permissiveness adds a differentiated angle as MiCA harmonises the broader EU crypto-asset licensing landscape and removes some of the advantage of jurisdiction-shopping. Whether MiCA’s standardisation ultimately pulls authorisation activity toward larger member states or further cements Baltic footholds will be a dynamic worth watching through 2026 and 2027.

UN:BLOCK Fintech is positioned as a companion event to UN:BLOCK Europe, the broader annual conference scheduled for Riga on 10 and 11 March 2027. Registration is open at fintech.unblockeurope.com .

The post UN:BLOCK Fintech Conference to Convene 600 Leaders in Riga appeared first on The Fintech Times .

articles.title: 「中台灣賭王」九州集團總裁一審判 11 年、沒收 329 億，自建支付系統還收買警政監
articles.excerpt:
台中地院一審判九州博弈集團總裁陳政谷 11 年 8 月、沒收逾 329 億元。法院認定集團自建 OnePaid […]

〈 「中台灣賭王」九州集團總裁一審判 11 年、沒收 329 億，自建支付系統還收買警政監 〉這篇文章最早發佈於動區BlockTempo《 動區動趨-最具影響力的區塊鏈新聞媒體 》。

台中地院一審判九州博弈集團總裁陳政谷 11 年 8 月、沒收逾 329 億元。法院認定集團自建 OnePaid、1177PAY 兩套第三方支付系統收賭金，並向時任台中市刑大大隊長行賄換取偵查情資；全案仍可上訴。 （前情提要：九州娛樂博弈洗錢438億創台紀錄！台灣賭王拿「百元鈔磚」砸員工打賞） （背景補充：88會館洗錢案：郭哲敏一審判刑11年8月！靠跨境匯兌與USDT洗錢超過200億） 台中地院 10 月 2 日對九州博弈集團案做出一審宣判：總裁陳政谷在組織犯罪與行賄兩罪下，合併應執行 11 年 8 月，法院另外沒收逾 329 億元不法營業額。特別的是，賭博集團連收錢的管道都自己蓋：旗下公司開發 OnePaid 與 1177PAY 兩套第三方支付系統，專門替自家賭博網站收賭金。全案仍可上訴。 被告共 45 人，包括 35 名自然人與 10 家公司。前台灣電子競技聯盟董事長徐培菁合併應執行 7 年，陳政谷的重要助手史鎮康判 5 年，其餘 32 人刑期從 5 個月到 5 年 8 個月不等；10 家公司罰金 1,000 萬到 8,000 萬元。 賭金怎麼進來：虛擬帳號、水房、人頭戶 合議庭認定，集團內部分工相當細：賭博網站由剛谷、翔谷與歐博森三家公司經營維護，客群橫跨台灣、中國、越南、菲律賓與印尼。 支付端則另闢兩條線，剛谷做出 OnePaid，壹壹柒柒做出 1177PAY，法院認定兩者的用途就是接上網站的非法資金。檢方 2024 年起訴時指控，集團 2017 年至 2023 年 5 月間透過這兩套系統，向賭客收取約 438 億元賭金。 自建支付系統怎麼把賭金變乾淨？調查局 2024 年偵辦時，曾說明這套系統的運作方式： 賭博網站用人頭公司註冊成第三方支付公司的「商戶會員」 支付公司發給賭客一組虛擬帳號，賭客照著匯款 虛擬帳號實際上連到支付公司自己的實體帳戶，錢先收進這裡 「水房」人員再用網路銀行，把款項撥到假商戶的人頭帳戶 收款端與撥款端都握在同一個集團手裡，銀行看到的只是支付公司與商戶之間的往來，賭客與賭場的關係就被切斷。 判決接著交代錢的下一站：剛谷的資金轉入葳群科技，支應薪資與新博弈平台的開發；其餘靠境外公司、跨境匯款、地下匯兌與投資公司轉白，也經捌捌玖玖、新鑫投入豪車租賃買賣，並透過采呈、東揮買地蓋建案。 行賄到刑大大隊長：名車、酒店公寓與 258 萬元威士忌 法院另認定，2023 年 2 月至 2024 年 5 月間，陳政谷與徐培菁為了讓九州免受追查，向時任台中市刑大大隊長、後升任刑事局警政監的林明佐（已改名林康承）行賄，換取偵查秘密。 好處從現金到名車都有。起點是徐培菁的 20 萬元匯款；接著，林明佐免費用上一輛 Range Rover Sport P400，這輛車的市價為 462 萬元，折算約省下 40 萬 1,000 元租金。他在台中另有一間酒店式公寓套房可住，同樣由徐培菁安排，租金利益約 26 萬 1,000 元。 生活層面的招待之外，還有幾筆禮物。法院認定，陳政谷透過徐培菁轉送高級普洱茶，也談妥讓林明佐用上一台紅外線機，價值 120 萬元。最貴的一件是威士忌：搜索情資到手後，陳政谷想表達謝意，便指示徐培菁把一瓶價值 258 萬元、年份 71 年的麥卡倫 RED 系列酒款送去。 林明佐本人這次沒有被判決。他因罹患惡性脊髓腫瘤住院、臥床，無法出庭，辯論未能完成，法院將他的部分分開審理。檢方 2024 年 8 月起訴時，指控他違背職務收賄、包庇犯罪組織、包庇賭博、洩密與洗錢等罪，這些都是檢方指控，仍待後續審理。 329 億對 438 億：重判的關鍵在搜索之後 沒收金額與檢方主張有落差。檢方估算不法所得達 438 億元，法院則認為這個推估明顯偏高，最終只沒收剛谷的不法營業額 316 億 9,044 萬元，加上壹壹柒柒的 12 億 9,950 萬元，合計逾 329 億元。 法院量刑時看的是偵辦過程中的反應。檢警準備搜索剛谷的風聲走漏，被告馬上大批銷毀證據；搜索之後集團沒有停手，核心被告要求下屬回報個人狀況，葳群公司也繼續讓不法資金流入。陳政谷等人多半否認犯行，或只認較輕的罪名，法院因此從重量刑。 相關報導 行銷公司員工猝死牽出 201 億 USDT 洗錢平台，台灣只是分據點 百億賭王林秉文在柬埔寨遭槍殺身亡，88 會館洗錢案關鍵人物暴力落幕 articles.title: Zilch Adds Membership Tiers, Pay Monthly and Salary Advance
articles.excerpt:
The UK BNPL platform is rolling out two paid membership tiers and two new credit features as it broadens beyond instalment payments.

The post Zilch Adds Membership Tiers, Pay Monthly and Salary Advance appeared first on The Fintech Times .

Zilch has launched what it describes as its most significant product expansion since the company was founded in 2019, introducing two paid membership tiers alongside a longer-term instalment option and an open banking salary advance feature. 

The London-based payments platform is rolling out Zilch Extra, priced at £2.99 a month, and Zilch Plus at £3.99 a month. Extra members gain access to open banking income verification, sharper personalised offers and spending insights. Plus members receive all of that alongside higher rewards rates on debit purchases (up to 6% back), rewards on credit purchases, a free physical card, and free foreign exchange, the last of these due in August. Both tiers are available at flat all-inclusive pricing with no hidden charges, according to the company.

 The new credit products 

 Philip Belamant, CEO and co-founder at Zilch 

Pay Monthly allows eligible customers to spread purchases of £75 or more over six or 12 months. The representative APR is 14.9%, with fees disclosed at checkout before confirmation. Zilch says the product operates within a customer’s existing regulated credit agreement rather than requiring a separate application, a design choice intended to reduce friction. The feature addresses demand from customers who want instalment flexibility on larger purchases without resorting to high-interest credit cards or unsecured personal loans.

Zilch Advance uses AI-enabled open banking and income verification to give eligible members access to up to £100 of their salary up to seven days before payday. The advance is repaid automatically when the member’s income lands and is likewise housed within the existing regulated credit agreement. Access to the income verification process that gates eligibility for Advance is itself a feature of the Zilch Extra tier, which creates a commercial incentive toward paid membership.

Chief executive and co-founder Philip Belamant said the expansion was a continuation of the company’s founding mission: “We started Zilch to eliminate the high cost of consumer credit. Six years on, we are continuing to deliver on that mission, giving customers one smart place to manage their spending, with flexible ways to pay, real-time rewards and smart tools that keep them in control.”

Zilch cited its Credit Confidence Study, conducted by YouGov in April 2026 across 10,940 UK adults, as the basis for the new products. The research found that 45% of credit users want rewards from their credit products and 47% want those products to help them manage spending. The company drives more than £2.5 billion annually to partner merchants, according to its own figures.

 Market context 

The launch reflects a broader strategic pivot that several buy now, pay later operators have been navigating since the UK government announced plans to bring BNPL products within the scope of FCA regulation. The regulatory transition has pushed providers toward structured credit agreements, transparent pricing and affordability checks, all features Zilch emphasises in this release. The company’s decision to anchor new products within existing regulated credit agreements rather than create standalone facilities suggests it is positioning ahead of compliance requirements rather than adapting to them retrospectively.

The earned wage access segment, which Zilch Advance enters, is itself under regulatory scrutiny in the UK. The FCA has been developing its approach to salary advance products, and firms operating in this space face questions about whether such products constitute regulated credit and what disclosures are required. Zilch’s choice to route Advance through the existing credit agreement framework rather than as a standalone earned wage access tool is a notable structural decision.

Competitors across the instalment and BNPL space, including Klarna , Clearpay and newer credit-building entrants, have also been extending product depth with loyalty mechanics and longer repayment terms. The membership model is a less common format in this segment and, if it achieves meaningful uptake, would give Zilch a recurring revenue stream that is more predictable than transaction-based income alone. The rollout is being phased progressively across the customer base over the coming months, so headline adoption figures are unlikely to be available for several quarters.

The post Zilch Adds Membership Tiers, Pay Monthly and Salary Advance appeared first on The Fintech Times .

articles.title: OBOOK Holdings Flags OwlPay Harbor Hit $130m Annualised volume
articles.excerpt:
OBOOK says its digital currency cross-border payments platform reached $130m in annualised run-rate volume, though H1 2026 revenue came in at under $4m.

The post OBOOK Holdings Flags OwlPay Harbor Hit $130m Annualised volume appeared first on The Fintech Times .

OBOOK Holdings (NASDAQ: OWLS), the Taiwan-headquartered fintech operating globally under the OwlTing brand, has released preliminary unaudited revenue for the first half of 2026 and an operating update for OwlPay Harbor, its digital currency-based cross-border enterprise payments platform. The results land ahead of a full unaudited earnings release scheduled for 21 August 2026. 

 The numbers 

 Darren Wang, founder and CEO of OwlTing Group 

Consolidated revenue for the six months ended 30 June 2026 is expected to come in between US$3.85 million and US$3.90 million, with the substantial majority generated by OBOOK’s established Taiwan-based businesses. Harbor, the newer platform, contributed only modestly to the first-half revenue line because most contracted enterprise clients were still working through integration, compliance review and pilot transaction stages during the period.

The operating update for Harbor tells a different story. Based on completed payment activity during July, the platform reached an annualised payment volume of approximately US$96 million. Using the trailing 30 days to 13 August 2026, that annualised run-rate climbed to approximately US$130 million. The company also reported six consecutive months of sequential volume growth, with July payment volume rising 107.6% over June and transaction count growing 109.5%. OBOOK says the transaction-count growth indicates the uptick is driven by a rising number of completed payments rather than a small number of large individual transactions, a distinction that matters for assessing platform depth. As of 31 July, Harbor had 79 contracted enterprise clients at various stages of integration and production.

Chief executive Darren Wang said the company had spent more than five years building regulatory capabilities, banking and settlement relationships, and compliance systems before entering commercial scaling. “Harbor entered commercial scaling only approximately six months ago, and it has delivered sequential payment volume growth in every month since,” he said. Chief financial officer Winnie Lin added that a significant portion of the infrastructure supporting Harbor is already in place, suggesting operating leverage as volume scales.

 Market context and what to watch 

The cross-border enterprise payments segment is highly competitive. Established players such as Wise Business , Airwallex , Nium and Convera compete on corridor depth, settlement speed and pricing, alongside bank-owned international transfer products. OBOOK’s positioning, using digital currencies as a settlement rail with recipients receiving local fiat into bank accounts, mirrors a model several other fintechs have pursued as a way to reduce correspondent banking costs on difficult corridors, particularly in Asia and emerging markets.

The regulatory read-across is important here. Platforms using stablecoins or other digital currencies as settlement intermediaries face evolving oversight in virtually every major market. In the European Union, MiCA establishes a clear licensing framework for crypto-asset service providers; in the US, stablecoin legislation remains contested; and in Asia, frameworks vary significantly by jurisdiction. OBOOK operates subsidiaries across Singapore, Hong Kong, Japan, Thailand, Malaysia and Poland, meaning the compliance map is complex. The release notes that OwlPay earns transaction-based fees, but does not disclose the yield per corridor, which limits any independent assessment of revenue quality relative to volume.

Payment volume, as OBOOK itself acknowledges, is an operating measure and not a revenue figure. Investors tracking this story will want to see what portion of the 79 contracted clients have moved into recurring production activity, how revenue yield evolves as the client mix matures, and whether the trajectory holds through the full second-half period.

The post OBOOK Holdings Flags OwlPay Harbor Hit $130m Annualised volume appeared first on The Fintech Times .

articles.title: 加密業支付商 OpenPayd 拚年底那斯達克掛牌，明年 4 月進軍美國
articles.excerpt:
Kraken、OKX 的出入金服務商 OpenPayd 執行長表示，與 SPAC Titan 的合併案已進入 SEC 審查最後階段，預計年底前在那斯達克掛牌，2027 年 4 月前推出美國服務，並計畫以上市股票進行併購。

這篇文章 加密業支付商 OpenPayd 拚年底那斯達克掛牌，明年 4 月進軍美國 最早出現於 鏈新聞 ABMedia 。

為 Kraken、OKX 等加密業者提供法幣出入金服務的支付基礎設施商 OpenPayd，預計今年底前完成在那斯達克（Nasdaq）掛牌。執行長 Iana Dimitrova 接受 CoinDesk 專訪 時表示，上市資金將用於進軍美國與後續併購，目標在 2027 年 4 月前向美國客戶推出服務。

與 SPAC Titan 合併，SEC 審查進入最後階段

OpenPayd 總部位於倫敦，今年 6 月 宣布 與特殊目的收購公司（SPAC）Titan Acquisition Corp. 簽署合併協議，完成後將以代號「OP」在那斯達克交易。依公司公告，交易以預估合併後基礎計算，給予 OpenPayd 11.45 億美元的股權價值；若 Titan 公眾股東未贖回，OpenPayd 最多可從 Titan 信託帳戶取得 2.76 億美元。

Dimitrova 表示，合併案目前處於美國證券交易委員會（SEC）審查的最後階段，除非出現重大外部變數，預計今年內完成。交易仍須待註冊文件生效、Titan 股東會通過等條件。

她也提到，美國加密市場結構立法延宕是一項挫折，但沒有改變 OpenPayd 進軍美國的決定。美國參議院 9 月未能推進 《清晰法案》 。

年營收 7,300 萬美元，9 月納入 43 州匯款執照

根據 Titan 向 SEC 提交的 投資人簡報 ，OpenPayd 截至 2026 年 4 月 30 日的財年營收為 7,300 萬美元，前一財年為 5,700 萬美元；EBITDA 為 1,300 萬美元。CoinDesk 報導指出，該年度淨損 280 萬美元，公司發言人表示，虧損全數來自與合併案相關的 580 萬美元一次性交易成本。

美國布局方面，OpenPayd 9 月 宣布 將美國持牌貨幣服務業者 MSB USA 納入集團，取得 43 個州的貨幣傳輸執照。MSB USA 由 OpenPayd 創辦人 Ozan Ozerk 創立。公司同時表示，截至 7 月底年化經常性營收（ARR）逾 9,600 萬美元，客戶超過 1,200 家，包括 Kraken、eToro、OKX 與做市商 B2C2。

OpenPayd 提供企業帳戶、外匯、國內外支付，以及法幣與 穩定幣 之間的兌換基礎設施，已串接 Circle 的跨境支付網路 Circle Payments Network，也加入 Fireblocks 的支付網路。

掛牌後擬以股票做併購，也考慮合併前私募

Dimitrova 表示，進入新市場時，收購會扮演更重要的角色，OpenPayd 對能帶來執照或技術，並讓公司比自行建置更快上線的企業有興趣。掛牌後公司可同時取得資金，以及能用於交易與合作的上市股票。

她也透露，公司正考慮在合併完成前進行私募，為成長計畫籌措資金。Dimitrova 認為，美國在跨境支付與穩定幣服務兩方面都有機會。

這篇文章 加密業支付商 OpenPayd 拚年底那斯達克掛牌，明年 4 月進軍美國 最早出現於 鏈新聞 ABMedia 。
